From stdpp Require Import relations.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang typing.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.

Section soundness.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Theorem soundness_tini (e : expr) v1 v2 v1' v2' ℓ ℓ' :
    ℓ' ⋢ ζ →
    ℓ  ⊑ ζ →
    [TBool @ (LLabel ℓ')] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ e : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ) →
    [] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ #v1 : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ') →
    [] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ #v2 : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ') →
    ((∃ σ1, rtc pstep (e.[# v1/], ∅) (# v1', σ1)) ∧
     (∃ σ2, rtc pstep (e.[# v2/], ∅) (# v2', σ2))) →
    v1' = v2'.

End soundness.

From logrel_ifc.prelude Require Export base.

From stdpp Require Import gmap countable.

Module lambda_sec.

Inductive binop := Add | Sub | Mult | Eq | Le | Lt.

Record loc := { loc_car : Z }.

Global Instance loc_eq_decision : EqDecision loc := ltac:(solve_decision).

Global Instance loc_countable : Countable loc :=
  ltac:(apply (inj_countable' loc_car (λ i, {| loc_car := i |})); intros []; done).

Inductive expr :=
  | Var (x : var)
  | Lam (e : {bind expr})
  | App (e1 e2 : expr)
  | LetIn (e1 : expr) (e2 : {bind expr})
  | Seq (e1 e2 : expr)

  | Unit
  | Bool (b : bool)
  | Nat (n : nat)
  | BinOp (op : binop) (e1 e2 : expr)
  | If (e0 e1 e2 : expr)

  | Pair (e1 e2 : expr)
  | Proj1 (e : expr)
  | Proj2 (e : expr)

  | InjL (e : expr)
  | InjR (e : expr)
  | Case (e0 : expr) (e1 e2 : {bind expr})

  | Loc (l : loc)
  | Alloc (e : expr)
  | Store (e1 e2 : expr)
  | Load (e : expr)

  | TLam (e : expr)
  | TApp (e : expr)

  | TLLam (e : expr)
  | TLApp (e : expr)

  | Pack (e : expr)
  | Unpack (e1 : expr) (e2 : {bind expr})

  | Fold (e : expr)
  | Unfold (e : expr)
  .

Instance Ids_expr : Ids expr := ltac:(derive).
Instance Rename_expr : Rename expr := ltac:(derive).
Instance Subst_expr : Subst expr := ltac:(derive).

Inductive val :=
  | UnitV
  | BoolV (b : bool)
  | NatV (n : nat)
  | LamV (e : expr)
  | TLamV (e : expr)
  | TLLamV (e : expr)
  | PairV (l r: val)
  | InjLV (v: val)
  | InjRV (v: val)
  | LocV (l : loc)
  | FoldV (v : val)
  | PackV (v : val).

Fixpoint of_val (v : val) : expr :=
    match v with
    | UnitV => Unit
    | BoolV b => Bool b
    | NatV n => Nat n
    | LamV e => Lam e
    | TLamV e => TLam e
    | TLLamV e => TLLam e
    | PairV v1 v2 => Pair (of_val v1) (of_val v2)
    | InjLV v => InjL (of_val v)
    | InjRV v => InjR (of_val v)
    | LocV l => Loc l
    | FoldV v => Fold (of_val v)
    | PackV v => Pack (of_val v)
    end.

Notation "# v" := (of_val v) (at level 20).

Definition binop_eval (op : binop) (a b : nat) : val :=
    match op with
    | Add => NatV (a + b)
    | Sub => NatV (a - b)
    | Mult => NatV (a * b)
    | Eq => BoolV $ bool_decide (a = b)
    | Le => BoolV $ bool_decide (a ≤ b)
    | Lt => BoolV $ bool_decide (a < b)
    end.

Fixpoint to_val (e : expr) : option val :=
    match e with
    | Unit => Some UnitV
    | Bool b => Some $ BoolV b
    | Nat n => Some $ NatV n
    | Lam e => Some $ LamV e
    | TLam e => Some $ TLamV e
    | TLLam e => Some $ TLLamV e
    | Pair e1 e2 => v1 ← to_val e1; v2 ← to_val e2; Some $ PairV v1 v2
    | InjL e => InjLV <$> to_val e
    | InjR e => InjRV <$> to_val e
    | Loc l => Some $ LocV l
    | Fold e => v ← to_val e; Some (FoldV v)
    | Pack e => v ← to_val e; Some (PackV v)
    | _ => None
    end.

Inductive ectx_item :=
  | AppLCtx (e2 : expr)
  | AppRCtx (v1 : val)
  | LetInCtx (e2 : expr)
  | SeqCtx (e2 : expr)
  | TAppCtx
  | TLAppCtx
  | BinOpLCtx (op : binop) (e2 : expr)
  | BinOpRCtx (op : binop) (v1 : val)
  | IfCtx (e1 : {bind expr}) (e2 : {bind expr})
  | PairLCtx (e2 : expr)
  | PairRCtx (v1 : val)
  | InjLCtx | InjRCtx
  | Proj1Ctx | Proj2Ctx
  | CaseCtx (e1 : {bind expr}) (e2 : {bind expr})
  | AllocCtx | LoadCtx
  | StoreLCtx (e2 : expr)
  | StoreRCtx (v1 : val)
  | FoldCtx
  | UnfoldCtx
  | PackCtx
  | UnpackCtx (e : expr)
  .

Definition fill_item (Ki : ectx_item) (e : expr) : expr :=
    match Ki with
    | AppLCtx e2 => App e e2
    | AppRCtx v1 => App (# v1) e
    | LetInCtx e2 => LetIn e e2
    | SeqCtx e2 => Seq e e2
    | TAppCtx => TApp e
    | TLAppCtx => TLApp e
    | BinOpLCtx op e2 => BinOp op e e2
    | BinOpRCtx op v1 => BinOp op (# v1) e
    | IfCtx e1 e2 => If e e1 e2
    | PairLCtx e2 => Pair e e2
    | PairRCtx v1 => Pair (# v1) e
    | InjLCtx => InjL e | InjRCtx => InjR e
    | Proj1Ctx => Proj1 e | Proj2Ctx => Proj2 e
    | CaseCtx e1 e2 => Case e e1 e2
    | AllocCtx => Alloc e
    | LoadCtx => Load e
    | StoreLCtx e2 => Store e e2
    | StoreRCtx v1 => Store (# v1) e
    | FoldCtx => Fold e
    | UnfoldCtx => Unfold e
    | PackCtx => Pack e
    | UnpackCtx e' => Unpack e e'
    end.

Definition state : Type := gmap loc val.

Inductive head_step : expr → state → list Empty_set → expr → state → list expr → Prop :=

  | BetaS e1 e2 v2 σ :
      to_val e2 = Some v2 →
      head_step (App (Lam e1) e2) σ [] e1.[e2/] σ []

  | TBeta e σ :
      head_step (TApp (TLam e)) σ [] e σ []

  | LetInBetaS e1 e2 v2 σ :
      to_val e1 = Some v2 →
      head_step (LetIn e1 e2) σ [] e2.[e1/] σ []

  | SeqBetaS e1 e2 v2 σ :
      to_val e1 = Some v2 →
      head_step (Seq e1 e2) σ [] e2 σ []

  | LBeta e σ :
      head_step (TLApp (TLLam e)) σ [] e σ []

  | BinOpS op n1 n2 σ :
      head_step (BinOp op (Nat n1) (Nat n2)) σ [] (# (binop_eval op n1 n2)) σ []

  | IfFalseS e1 e2 σ :
      head_step (If (Bool false) e1 e2) σ [] e2 σ []
  | IfTrueS e1 e2 σ :
      head_step (If (Bool true) e1 e2) σ [] e1 σ []

  | Proj1S e1 e2 v1 v2 σ :
      to_val e1 = Some v1 →
      to_val e2 = Some v2 →
      head_step (Proj1 $ Pair e1 e2) σ [] (of_val v1) σ []
  | Proj2S e1 e2 v1 v2 σ :
      to_val e1 = Some v1 →
      to_val e2 = Some v2 →
      head_step (Proj2 $ Pair e1 e2) σ [] (of_val v2) σ []

  | CaseLS e0 e1 e2 v0 σ :
      to_val e0 = Some v0 →
      head_step (Case (InjL e0) e1 e2) σ [] (e1.[e0/]) σ []
  | CaseRS e0 e1 e2 v0 σ :
      to_val e0 = Some v0 →
      head_step (Case (InjR e0) e1 e2) σ [] (e2.[e0/]) σ []

  | AllocS e v l σ :
      to_val e = Some v →
      σ !! l = None →
      head_step (Alloc e) σ [] (Loc l) (<[l := v]>σ) []
  | StoreS e v l σ :
      to_val e = Some v →
      is_Some $ σ !! l →
      head_step (Store (Loc l) e) σ [] Unit (<[l := v]>σ) []
  | LoadS l v σ :
      σ !! l = Some v →
      head_step (Load $ Loc l) σ [] (of_val v) σ []

  | UnpackPackS e1 e2 v1 σ :
      to_val e1 = Some v1 →
      head_step (Unpack (Pack e1) e2) σ [] (e2.[e1/]) σ []

  | UnfoldFoldS e v σ :
      to_val e = Some v →
      head_step (Unfold (Fold e)) σ [] e σ []
  .

(* The Iris evaluation-context construction specialized to lambda_sec. *)
Definition fill (K : list ectx_item) (e : expr) : expr :=
  foldl (flip fill_item) e K.

Inductive prim_step (e1 : expr) (σ1 : state) (κ : list Empty_set)
    (e2 : expr) (σ2 : state) (efs : list expr) : Prop :=
| Ectx_step K e1' e2' :
    e1 = fill K e1' → e2 = fill K e2' →
    head_step e1' σ1 κ e2' σ2 efs →
    prim_step e1 σ1 κ e2 σ2 efs.

Notation pstep := (λ x1 x2, prim_step (fst x1) (snd x1) [] (fst x2) (snd x2) []).

End lambda_sec.

Export lambda_sec.

Definition is_atomic (e : expr) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | Alloc e => is_Some (to_val e)
  | Load e =>  is_Some (to_val e)
  | Store e1 e2 => is_Some (to_val e1) ∧ is_Some (to_val e2)
  | _ => False
  end.

From Autosubst Require Export Autosubst.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang lattice.

Section syntactic_flowsto.

Inductive label_term `{SecurityLattice label} :=
  | LVar (x : var)
  | LJoin (l l' : label_term)
  | LLabel (ℓ : label).

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Global Instance label_term_ids : Ids label_term := ltac:(derive).
Global Instance label_term_rename : Rename label_term := ltac:(derive).
Global Instance label_term_subst : Subst label_term := ltac:(derive).

Inductive flowsto : label_term → label_term  → Prop :=
  | FRefl l :
      flowsto l l
  | FTrans l1 l2 l3 :
      flowsto l1 l2 →
      flowsto l2 l3 →
      flowsto l1 l3
  | FBottom l :
      flowsto (LLabel ⊥) l
  | FTop l :
      flowsto l (LLabel ⊤)
  | FLabel ℓ1 ℓ2 :
      ℓ1 ⊑ ℓ2 →
      flowsto (LLabel ℓ1) (LLabel ℓ2)
  | FJoin l1 l2 l3 :
      flowsto l1 l3 →
      flowsto l2 l3 →
      flowsto (LJoin l1 l2) l3.

End syntactic_flowsto.

Notation "a ⊑ₛ b" := (flowsto a b) (at level 70) : stdpp_scope.

Infix "⊔ₛ" := (LJoin) (at level 50) : stdpp_scope.

Notation "⊥ₛ" := (LLabel bot) : stdpp_scope.

Notation "⊤ₛ" := (LLabel top) : stdpp_scope.

Section lambda_sec_types.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Inductive type :=
  | TUnit
  | TBool
  | TNat
  | TVar (x : var)
  | TRef (τ : sectype)
  | TArrow (ℓₑ : label_term) (τ1 τ2 : sectype)
  | TProd (τ1 τ2 : sectype)
  | TSum (τ1 τ2 : sectype)
  | TForall (ℓₑ : label_term) (τ : sectype)
  | TLForall (ℓₑ : label_term) (τ : sectype)
  | TExist (τ : sectype)
  | TRec (τ : sectype)
  with sectype :=
  | TSec (ℓ : label_term) (t : type).

Global Instance Ids_type : Ids type := ltac:(derive).
Global Instance Ids_sectype : Ids sectype := λ n, TSec ⊥ₛ TUnit.

Implicit Types t : type.

Implicit Types τ : sectype.

Scheme type_mut := Induction for type Sort Prop
    with sectype_mut := Induction for sectype Sort Prop.

Notation "t @ ℓ" := (TSec ℓ t) (at level 40).

Fixpoint hsubst_label_type (sigma : var → label_term) (t : type) : type :=
    let _ := hsubst_label_sectype : HSubst label_term sectype in
    match t with
    | TUnit
    | TBool | TNat => t
    | TVar x => TVar x
    | TRef τ => TRef (hsubst sigma τ)
    | TArrow ℓ' τ1 τ2 => TArrow ℓ'.[sigma] (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TProd τ1 τ2 => TProd (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TSum τ1 τ2 => TSum (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TForall ℓ τ => TForall ℓ.[sigma] (hsubst sigma τ)
    | TLForall ℓ τ => TLForall ℓ.[up sigma] (hsubst (up sigma) τ)
    | TExist τ => TExist (hsubst sigma τ)
    | TRec τ => TRec (hsubst sigma τ)
    end
  with hsubst_label_sectype (sigma : var → label_term) (τ : sectype) : sectype :=
    let _ := hsubst_label_type : HSubst label_term type in
    match τ with
    | t @ ℓ => (hsubst sigma t) @ ℓ.[sigma]
    end.

Global Instance HSubst_label_type : HSubst label_term type := hsubst_label_type.
Global Instance HSubst_label_sectype : HSubst label_term sectype := hsubst_label_sectype.

Fixpoint rename_type (xi : var → var) (t : type) : type :=
    let _ := rename_sectype : Rename sectype in
    match t with
    | TUnit
    | TBool | TNat => t
    | TVar x => TVar (xi x)
    | TRef τ => TRef (rename xi τ)
    | TArrow ℓ' τ1 τ2 => TArrow ℓ' (rename xi τ1) (rename xi τ2)
    | TProd τ1 τ2 => TProd (rename xi τ1) (rename xi τ2)
    | TSum τ1 τ2 => TSum (rename xi τ1) (rename xi τ2)
    | TForall ℓ τ => TForall ℓ (rename (upren xi) τ)
    | TLForall ℓ τ => TLForall ℓ (rename xi τ)
    | TExist τ => TExist (rename (upren xi) τ)
    | TRec τ => TRec (rename (upren xi) τ)
    end
  with rename_sectype (xi : var → var) (τ : sectype) : sectype :=
    let _ := rename_type : Rename type in
    match τ with
    | t @ ℓ => (rename xi t) @ ℓ
    end.

Global Instance Rename_type : Rename type := rename_type.
Global Instance Rename_sectype : Rename sectype := rename_sectype.

Fixpoint subst_type (sigma : var → type) (t : type) : type :=
    let _ := hsubst_sectype : HSubst type sectype in
    match t with
    | TUnit
    | TBool | TNat => t
    | TVar x => sigma x
    | TRef τ => TRef (hsubst sigma τ)
    | TArrow ℓ' τ1 τ2 => TArrow ℓ' (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TProd τ1 τ2 => TProd (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TSum τ1 τ2 => TSum (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TForall ℓ τ => TForall ℓ (hsubst (up sigma) τ)
    | TLForall ℓ τ => TLForall ℓ (hsubst (sigma >>| ren (+1)) τ)
    | TExist τ => TExist (hsubst (up sigma) τ)
    | TRec τ => TRec (hsubst (up sigma) τ)
    end
  with hsubst_sectype (sigma : var → type) (τ : sectype) : sectype :=
    let _ := subst_type : Subst type in
    match τ with
    | t @ ℓ => (subst sigma t) @ ℓ
    end.

Global Instance Subst_type : Subst type := subst_type.
Global Instance HSubst_type : HSubst type sectype := hsubst_sectype.

End lambda_sec_types.

Notation "τ @ ℓ" := (TSec ℓ τ) (at level 60).

1	From Autosubst Require Export Autosubst.
2	
3	From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang lattice types.
4	
5	Section lambda_sec_typing.
6	
7	Context `{SecurityLattice label}.
8	
9	Inductive subtype : type → type → Prop :=
10	  | TSubRefl t :
11	      subtype t t
12	  | TSubTrans t1 t2 t3 :
13	      subtype t1 t2 → subtype t2 t3 → subtype t1 t3
14	  | TArrowSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
15	      secsubtype τ1' τ1 →
16	      secsubtype τ2 τ2' →
17	      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
18	      subtype (TArrow ℓₑ1 τ1 τ2) (TArrow ℓₑ2 τ1' τ2')
19	  | TForallSub τ1 τ2 ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
20	      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
21	      secsubtype τ1 τ2 →
22	      subtype (TForall ℓₑ1 τ1) (TForall ℓₑ2 τ2)
23	  | TLForallSub τ1 τ2 ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
24	      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
25	      secsubtype τ1 τ2 →
26	      subtype (TLForall ℓₑ1 τ1) (TLForall ℓₑ2 τ2)
27	  | TProdSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
28	      secsubtype τ1 τ1' → secsubtype τ2 τ2' → subtype (TProd τ1 τ2) (TProd τ1' τ2')
29	  | TSumSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
30	      secsubtype τ1 τ1' → secsubtype τ2 τ2' → subtype (TSum τ1 τ2) (TSum τ1' τ2')
31	
32	  | TRecSub τ1 τ2 :
33	
34	
35	      secsubtype τ1.|[TRec τ1/] τ2.|[TRec τ2/] →
36	      subtype (TRec τ1) (TRec τ2)
37	  with secsubtype :  sectype → sectype → Prop :=
38	  | TSubsec (ℓ ℓ' : label_term) (t t' : type) :
39	      ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓ' → subtype t t' → secsubtype (t @ ℓ) (t' @ ℓ').
40	
41	Scheme subtype_mut := Induction for subtype Sort Prop
42	    with secsubtype_mut := Induction for secsubtype Sort Prop.
43	
44	Notation "t1 '<:' t2" := (subtype t1 t2) (at level 70).
45	
46	Notation "τ1 '<:ₛ' τ2" := (secsubtype τ1 τ2) (at level 70).
47	
48	Definition type_flowsto τ ℓ :=
49	    let: t @ ℓ' := τ in ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓ'.
50	
51	Notation "τ ↘ ℓ" := (type_flowsto τ ℓ) (at level 70).
52	
53	Definition binop_type (op : binop) : type :=
54	    match op with
55	    | Add | Sub | Mult => TNat
56	    | Eq | Le | Lt => TBool
57	  end.
58	
59	Reserved Notation "Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ" (at level 74, e, τ at next level).
60	
61	Inductive typed (Γ : list sectype) (pc : label_term) : expr → sectype → Prop :=
62	  | Unit_typed : Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Unit : TUnit @ ⊥ₛ
63	  | Bool_typed b :
64	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Bool b : TBool @ ⊥ₛ
65	  | Nat_typed n :
66	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Nat n : TNat @ ⊥ₛ
67	  | Var_typed x τ :
68	      Γ !! x = Some τ →
69	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Var x : τ
70	  | Lam_typed e ℓₑ τ1 τ2 :
71	      τ1 :: Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ2 →
72	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Lam e : (TArrow ℓₑ τ1 τ2) @ ⊥ₛ
73	  | BinOp_typed e1 e2 op ℓ1 ℓ2 :
74	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : TNat @ ℓ1 →
75	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : TNat @ ℓ2 →
76	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ BinOp op e1 e2 : (binop_type op) @ (ℓ1 ⊔ₛ ℓ2)
77	  | App_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 ℓ ℓₑ :
78	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : (TArrow ℓₑ τ1 τ2) @ ℓ →
79	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ1 →
80	      τ2 ↘ ℓ →
81	      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ →
82	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ App e1 e2 : τ2
83	  | LetIn_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
84	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
85	      τ1 :: Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
86	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ LetIn e1 e2 : τ2
87	  | Seq_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
88	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
89	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
90	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Seq e1 e2 : τ2
91	  | TLam_typed e τ ℓₑ :
92	      hsubst_sectype (ren (+1)) <$> Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ →
93	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLam e : (TForall ℓₑ τ) @ ⊥ₛ
94	  | TApp_typed e τ t' ℓ ℓₑ :
95	      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ →
96	      τ.|[t'/] ↘ ℓ →
97	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : (TForall ℓₑ τ) @ ℓ →
98	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TApp e : τ.|[t'/]
99	  | TLLam_typed e τ ℓₑ :
100	      hsubst_label_sectype (ren (+1)) <$> Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ →
101	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLLam e : (TLForall ℓₑ τ) @ ⊥ₛ
102	  | TLApp_typed e τ (ℓ ℓ' ℓₑ : label_term) :
103	      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ.[ℓ'/] →
104	      τ.|[ℓ'/] ↘ ℓ →
105	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : (TLForall ℓₑ τ) @ ℓ →
106	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLApp e : τ.|[ℓ'/]
107	  | Cond_typed e e1 e2 τ ℓ :
108	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TBool @ ℓ →
109	      Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e1 : τ →
110	      Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
111	      τ ↘ ℓ →
112	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ If e e1 e2 : τ
113	  | Pair_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
114	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
115	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
116	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Pair e1 e2 : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
117	  | Proj1_typed e τ1 τ2 ℓ :
118	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
119	      τ1 ↘ ℓ →
120	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Proj1 e : τ1
121	  | Proj2_typed e τ1 τ2 ℓ :
122	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
123	      τ2 ↘ ℓ →
124	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Proj2 e : τ2
125	  | InjL_typed e τ1 τ2 :
126	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ1 →
127	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ InjL e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
128	  | InjR_typed e τ1 τ2 :
129	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ2 →
130	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ InjR e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
131	  | Case_typed e e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ ℓ :
132	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
133	       τ1 :: Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e1 : τ →
134	       τ2 :: Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
135	      τ ↘ ℓ →
136	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Case e e1 e2 : τ
137	  | Alloc_typed e τ :
138	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ →
139	      τ ↘ pc →
140	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Alloc e : TRef τ @ ⊥ₛ
141	  | Store_typed e1 e2 τ ℓ :
142	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : TRef τ @ ℓ →
143	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
144	      τ ↘ pc ⊔ₛ ℓ →
145	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Store e1 e2 : TUnit @ ⊥ₛ
146	  | Load_typed e τ τ' ℓ :
147	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TRef τ @ ℓ →
148	      τ <:ₛ τ' →
149	      τ' ↘ ℓ →
150	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Load e : τ'
151	  | TPack e τ t :
152	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ.|[t/] →
153	      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Pack e : TExist τ @ ⊥ₛ

From Autosubst Require Export Autosubst.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang lattice types.

Section lambda_sec_typing.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Inductive subtype : type → type → Prop :=
  | TSubRefl t :
      subtype t t
  | TSubTrans t1 t2 t3 :
      subtype t1 t2 → subtype t2 t3 → subtype t1 t3
  | TArrowSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
      secsubtype τ1' τ1 →
      secsubtype τ2 τ2' →
      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
      subtype (TArrow ℓₑ1 τ1 τ2) (TArrow ℓₑ2 τ1' τ2')
  | TForallSub τ1 τ2 ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
      secsubtype τ1 τ2 →
      subtype (TForall ℓₑ1 τ1) (TForall ℓₑ2 τ2)
  | TLForallSub τ1 τ2 ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
      secsubtype τ1 τ2 →
      subtype (TLForall ℓₑ1 τ1) (TLForall ℓₑ2 τ2)
  | TProdSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
      secsubtype τ1 τ1' → secsubtype τ2 τ2' → subtype (TProd τ1 τ2) (TProd τ1' τ2')
  | TSumSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
      secsubtype τ1 τ1' → secsubtype τ2 τ2' → subtype (TSum τ1 τ2) (TSum τ1' τ2')

  | TRecSub τ1 τ2 :


      secsubtype τ1.|[TRec τ1/] τ2.|[TRec τ2/] →
      subtype (TRec τ1) (TRec τ2)
  with secsubtype :  sectype → sectype → Prop :=
  | TSubsec (ℓ ℓ' : label_term) (t t' : type) :
      ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓ' → subtype t t' → secsubtype (t @ ℓ) (t' @ ℓ').

Scheme subtype_mut := Induction for subtype Sort Prop
    with secsubtype_mut := Induction for secsubtype Sort Prop.

Notation "t1 '<:' t2" := (subtype t1 t2) (at level 70).

Notation "τ1 '<:ₛ' τ2" := (secsubtype τ1 τ2) (at level 70).

Definition type_flowsto τ ℓ :=
    let: t @ ℓ' := τ in ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓ'.

Notation "τ ↘ ℓ" := (type_flowsto τ ℓ) (at level 70).

Definition binop_type (op : binop) : type :=
    match op with
    | Add | Sub | Mult => TNat
    | Eq | Le | Lt => TBool
  end.

Reserved Notation "Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ" (at level 74, e, τ at next level).

Inductive typed (Γ : list sectype) (pc : label_term) : expr → sectype → Prop :=
  | Unit_typed : Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Unit : TUnit @ ⊥ₛ
  | Bool_typed b :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Bool b : TBool @ ⊥ₛ
  | Nat_typed n :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Nat n : TNat @ ⊥ₛ
  | Var_typed x τ :
      Γ !! x = Some τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Var x : τ
  | Lam_typed e ℓₑ τ1 τ2 :
      τ1 :: Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Lam e : (TArrow ℓₑ τ1 τ2) @ ⊥ₛ
  | BinOp_typed e1 e2 op ℓ1 ℓ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : TNat @ ℓ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : TNat @ ℓ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ BinOp op e1 e2 : (binop_type op) @ (ℓ1 ⊔ₛ ℓ2)
  | App_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 ℓ ℓₑ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : (TArrow ℓₑ τ1 τ2) @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ1 →
      τ2 ↘ ℓ →
      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ App e1 e2 : τ2
  | LetIn_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
      τ1 :: Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ LetIn e1 e2 : τ2
  | Seq_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Seq e1 e2 : τ2
  | TLam_typed e τ ℓₑ :
      hsubst_sectype (ren (+1)) <$> Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLam e : (TForall ℓₑ τ) @ ⊥ₛ
  | TApp_typed e τ t' ℓ ℓₑ :
      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ →
      τ.|[t'/] ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : (TForall ℓₑ τ) @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TApp e : τ.|[t'/]
  | TLLam_typed e τ ℓₑ :
      hsubst_label_sectype (ren (+1)) <$> Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLLam e : (TLForall ℓₑ τ) @ ⊥ₛ
  | TLApp_typed e τ (ℓ ℓ' ℓₑ : label_term) :
      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ.[ℓ'/] →
      τ.|[ℓ'/] ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : (TLForall ℓₑ τ) @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLApp e : τ.|[ℓ'/]
  | Cond_typed e e1 e2 τ ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TBool @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e1 : τ →
      Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
      τ ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ If e e1 e2 : τ
  | Pair_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Pair e1 e2 : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
  | Proj1_typed e τ1 τ2 ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
      τ1 ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Proj1 e : τ1
  | Proj2_typed e τ1 τ2 ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
      τ2 ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Proj2 e : τ2
  | InjL_typed e τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ InjL e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
  | InjR_typed e τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ InjR e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
  | Case_typed e e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
       τ1 :: Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e1 : τ →
       τ2 :: Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
      τ ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Case e e1 e2 : τ
  | Alloc_typed e τ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ →
      τ ↘ pc →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Alloc e : TRef τ @ ⊥ₛ
  | Store_typed e1 e2 τ ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : TRef τ @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
      τ ↘ pc ⊔ₛ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Store e1 e2 : TUnit @ ⊥ₛ
  | Load_typed e τ τ' ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TRef τ @ ℓ →
      τ <:ₛ τ' →
      τ' ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Load e : τ'
  | TPack e τ t :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ.|[t/] →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Pack e : TExist τ @ ⊥ₛ
  | TUnpack e1 e2 τ1 τ2 ℓ :
      τ2 ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : TExist τ1 @ ℓ →
      τ1 :: (hsubst_sectype (ren (+1)) <$> Γ) # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e2 : (hsubst_sectype (ren (+1)) τ2) →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Unpack e1 e2 : τ2
  | TFold e τ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ.|[TRec τ/] →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Fold e : TRec τ @ ⊥ₛ
  | TUnfold e τ ℓ :
      τ.|[TRec τ/] ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TRec τ @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Unfold e : τ.|[TRec τ/]
  | Sub_typed e τ τ' pc' :
      Γ # pc' ⊢ₜ e : τ' →
      pc ⊑ₛ pc' →
      τ' <:ₛ τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ
  where "Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ" := (typed Γ pc e τ).

Fixpoint env_subst (vs : list val) : var → expr :=
    match vs with
    | [] => ids
    | v :: vs' => #v .: env_subst vs'
    end.

End lambda_sec_typing.

Notation "τ ↘ ℓ" := (type_flowsto τ ℓ) (at level 70).

Notation "t1 '<:' t2" := (subtype t1 t2) (at level 70).

Notation "τ1 '<:ₛ' τ2" := (secsubtype τ1 τ2) (at level 70).

Notation "Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ" := (typed Γ pc e τ) (at level 74, e, τ at next level).

  rewrite join_commutative. rewrite join_associative.
  rewrite (join_idempotent b). reflexivity.

Proof.
  intros a b c Ha Hb. unfold order in *.
  rewrite join_associative. rewrite Hb. exact Ha.
Qed.

Lemma order_bot : forall a : label, ⊥ ⊑ a.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply bot_left_id. Qed.

Lemma order_top : forall a : label, a ⊑ ⊤.

Lemma join_congr : forall a a' b b', a ≡ a' -> b ≡ b' -> a ⊔ b ≡ a' ⊔ b'.
Proof. intros. eapply (@join_proper label _). eauto. eauto. Qed.
Lemma order_join_l : forall a b : label, a ⊑ a ⊔ b.
Proof. intros a b. unfold order. transitivity ((a ⊔ a) ⊔ b).

 - apply join_congr. apply (@join_idempotent label _ a). reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma order_join_r : forall a b : label, b ⊑ a ⊔ b.
Proof. intros a b. unfold order. transitivity (b ⊔ (b ⊔ a)).
 - apply join_congr. reflexivity. apply (@join_commutative label _ a b).
 - transitivity ((b ⊔ b) ⊔ a).
   + apply (@join_associative label _ b b a).
   + transitivity (b ⊔ a).

     * apply (@join_commutative label _ b a). Qed.

     : ∀ (R : relation ?A) (x : ?A), rtc R x x
where
?A : [ |- Type]

?A : [ |- Type]

From stdpp Require Import relations.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang typing.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.

Section soundness.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Order facts for the security lattice.                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Local Instance lat_equiv_refl : Reflexive (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact R. Qed.
Local Instance lat_equiv_sym : Symmetric (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact S. Qed.
Local Instance lat_equiv_trans : Transitive (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact T. Qed.

Lemma join_congr : forall a a' b b' : label, a ≡ a' -> b ≡ b' -> a ⊔ b ≡ a' ⊔ b'.
Proof. intros. eapply (@join_proper label _). eauto. eauto. Qed.

Lemma order_join_l : forall a b : label, a ⊑ a ⊔ b.
Proof.
  intros a b. unfold order.
  transitivity ((a ⊔ a) ⊔ b).
  - apply (@join_associative label _ a a b).
  - apply join_congr. apply (@join_idempotent label _ a). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma order_join_r : forall a b : label, b ⊑ a ⊔ b.
Proof.
  intros a b. unfold order.
  transitivity (b ⊔ (b ⊔ a)).
  - apply join_congr. reflexivity. apply (@join_commutative label _ a b).
  - transitivity ((b ⊔ b) ⊔ a).
    + apply (@join_associative label _ b b a).
    + transitivity (b ⊔ a).
      * apply join_congr. apply (@join_idempotent label _ b). reflexivity.
      * apply (@join_commutative label _ b a).
Qed.

Lemma order_refl : forall a : label, a ⊑ a.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@join_idempotent label _ a). Qed.

Lemma order_trans : forall a b c : label, a ⊑ b -> b ⊑ c -> a ⊑ c.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. unfold order in *.
  transitivity (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)).
  - apply join_congr. reflexivity. symmetry. exact Hbc.
  - transitivity ((a ⊔ b) ⊔ c).
    + apply (@join_associative label _ a b c).
    + transitivity (b ⊔ c).
      * apply join_congr. exact Hab. reflexivity.
      * exact Hbc.
Qed.

Lemma order_join_lub : forall a b c : label, a ⊑ c -> b ⊑ c -> a ⊔ b ⊑ c.
Proof.
  intros a b c Ha Hb. unfold order in *.
  transitivity (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)).
  - symmetry. apply (@join_associative label _ a b c).
  - transitivity (a ⊔ c).
    + apply join_congr. reflexivity. exact Hb.
    + exact Ha.
Qed.

Lemma order_bot : forall a : label, ⊥ ⊑ a.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@bot_left_id label _ a). Qed.

Lemma order_top : forall a : label, a ⊑ ⊤.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@top_right_absorb label _ a). Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Label-term semantics and soundness of the syntactic flow relation.  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint interp_label (rho : var -> label) (l : label_term) : label :=
  match l with
  | LVar x => rho x
  | LJoin a b => interp_label rho a ⊔ interp_label rho b
  | LLabel x => x
  end.

Lemma interp_label_subst (rho : var -> label) (sigma : var -> label_term)
    (l : label_term) :
  interp_label rho l.[sigma] = interp_label (fun x => interp_label rho (sigma x)) l.
Proof. induction l; simpl; f_equal; assumption. Qed.

Lemma interp_label_ren (rho : var -> label) (xi : var -> var) (l : label_term) :
  interp_label rho l.[ren xi] = interp_label (fun x => rho (xi x)) l.
Proof. induction l; simpl; f_equal; assumption. Qed.

Lemma flowsto_sound (rho : var -> label) (l1 l2 : label_term) :
  l1 ⊑ₛ l2 -> interp_label rho l1 ⊑ interp_label rho l2.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl.
  - apply order_refl.
  - eapply order_trans; eauto.
  - apply order_bot.
  - apply order_top.
  - assumption.
  - apply order_join_lub; assumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Expression substitution lemmas (Autosubst).                         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Global Instance SubstLemmas_expr_inst : SubstLemmas expr := ltac:(derive).

Lemma expr_subst_comp (e : expr) (sigma tau : var -> expr) :
  e.[sigma].[tau] = e.[sigma >> tau].
Proof. apply subst_comp. Qed.

Lemma expr_subst_id (e : expr) : e.[ids] = e.
Proof. apply subst_id. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Filling evaluation contexts.                                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma fill_nil (e : expr) : fill [] e = e.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fill_cons (Ki : ectx_item) (K : list ectx_item) (e : expr) :
  fill (Ki :: K) e = fill K (fill_item Ki e).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fill_app (K1 K2 : list ectx_item) (e : expr) :
  fill (K1 ++ K2) e = fill K1 (fill K2 e).
Proof.
  revert e. induction K1; intros e; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHK1. reflexivity.
Qed.

End soundness.

Theorem soundness_tini (e : expr) v1 v2 v1' v2' ℓ ℓ' :
    ℓ' ⋢ ζ →
    ℓ  ⊑ ζ →
    [TBool @ (LLabel ℓ')] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ e : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ) →
    [] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ #v1 : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ') →

Proof.
  intros Hhigh Hlow He Hv1 Hv2 Hrun.
Abort.

From stdpp Require Export prelude.

From Autosubst Require Export Autosubst.

Class IdsLemmas (term : Type) {Ids_term : Ids term} := {
  ids_inj x y : ids x = ids y → x = y
}.

Section Autosubst_Lemmas.

Context {term : Type} {Ids_term : Ids term}
          {Rename_term : Rename term} {Subst_term : Subst term}
          {SubstLemmas_term : SubstLemmas term}
          {IdsLeamms_term : IdsLemmas term}.

End Autosubst_Lemmas.

Reserved Notation "⟦ τ ⟧" (at level 0, τ at level 70).

Reserved Notation "⟦ τ ⟧ₑ" (at level 0, τ at level 70).

Reserved Notation "⟦ Γ ⟧*" (at level 0, Γ at level 70).
=====LANG=====
From logrel_ifc.prelude Require Export base.

From stdpp Require Import gmap countable.

Module lambda_sec.

Inductive binop := Add | Sub | Mult | Eq | Le | Lt.

Record loc := { loc_car : Z }.

Global Instance loc_eq_decision : EqDecision loc := ltac:(solve_decision).

Global Instance loc_countable : Countable loc :=
  ltac:(apply (inj_countable' loc_car (λ i, {| loc_car := i |})); intros []; done).

Inductive expr :=
  | Var (x : var)
  | Lam (e : {bind expr})
  | App (e1 e2 : expr)
  | LetIn (e1 : expr) (e2 : {bind expr})
  | Seq (e1 e2 : expr)

  | Unit
  | Bool (b : bool)
  | Nat (n : nat)
  | BinOp (op : binop) (e1 e2 : expr)
  | If (e0 e1 e2 : expr)

  | Pair (e1 e2 : expr)
  | Proj1 (e : expr)
  | Proj2 (e : expr)

  | InjL (e : expr)
  | InjR (e : expr)
  | Case (e0 : expr) (e1 e2 : {bind expr})

  | Loc (l : loc)
  | Alloc (e : expr)
  | Store (e1 e2 : expr)
  | Load (e : expr)

  | TLam (e : expr)
  | TApp (e : expr)

  | TLLam (e : expr)
  | TLApp (e : expr)

  | Pack (e : expr)
  | Unpack (e1 : expr) (e2 : {bind expr})

  | Fold (e : expr)
  | Unfold (e : expr)
  .

Instance Ids_expr : Ids expr := ltac:(derive).
Instance Rename_expr : Rename expr := ltac:(derive).
Instance Subst_expr : Subst expr := ltac:(derive).

Inductive val :=
  | UnitV
  | BoolV (b : bool)
  | NatV (n : nat)
  | LamV (e : expr)
  | TLamV (e : expr)
  | TLLamV (e : expr)
  | PairV (l r: val)
  | InjLV (v: val)
  | InjRV (v: val)
  | LocV (l : loc)
  | FoldV (v : val)
  | PackV (v : val).

Fixpoint of_val (v : val) : expr :=
    match v with
    | UnitV => Unit
    | BoolV b => Bool b
    | NatV n => Nat n
    | LamV e => Lam e
    | TLamV e => TLam e
    | TLLamV e => TLLam e
    | PairV v1 v2 => Pair (of_val v1) (of_val v2)
    | InjLV v => InjL (of_val v)
    | InjRV v => InjR (of_val v)
    | LocV l => Loc l
    | FoldV v => Fold (of_val v)
    | PackV v => Pack (of_val v)
    end.

Notation "# v" := (of_val v) (at level 20).

Definition binop_eval (op : binop) (a b : nat) : val :=
    match op with
    | Add => NatV (a + b)
    | Sub => NatV (a - b)
    | Mult => NatV (a * b)
    | Eq => BoolV $ bool_decide (a = b)
    | Le => BoolV $ bool_decide (a ≤ b)
    | Lt => BoolV $ bool_decide (a < b)
    end.

Fixpoint to_val (e : expr) : option val :=
    match e with
    | Unit => Some UnitV
    | Bool b => Some $ BoolV b
    | Nat n => Some $ NatV n
    | Lam e => Some $ LamV e
    | TLam e => Some $ TLamV e
    | TLLam e => Some $ TLLamV e
    | Pair e1 e2 => v1 ← to_val e1; v2 ← to_val e2; Some $ PairV v1 v2
    | InjL e => InjLV <$> to_val e
    | InjR e => InjRV <$> to_val e
    | Loc l => Some $ LocV l
    | Fold e => v ← to_val e; Some (FoldV v)
    | Pack e => v ← to_val e; Some (PackV v)
    | _ => None
    end.

Inductive ectx_item :=
  | AppLCtx (e2 : expr)
  | AppRCtx (v1 : val)
  | LetInCtx (e2 : expr)
  | SeqCtx (e2 : expr)
  | TAppCtx
  | TLAppCtx
  | BinOpLCtx (op : binop) (e2 : expr)
  | BinOpRCtx (op : binop) (v1 : val)
  | IfCtx (e1 : {bind expr}) (e2 : {bind expr})
  | PairLCtx (e2 : expr)
  | PairRCtx (v1 : val)
  | InjLCtx | InjRCtx
  | Proj1Ctx | Proj2Ctx
  | CaseCtx (e1 : {bind expr}) (e2 : {bind expr})
  | AllocCtx | LoadCtx
  | StoreLCtx (e2 : expr)
  | StoreRCtx (v1 : val)
  | FoldCtx
  | UnfoldCtx
  | PackCtx
  | UnpackCtx (e : expr)
  .

Definition fill_item (Ki : ectx_item) (e : expr) : expr :=
    match Ki with
    | AppLCtx e2 => App e e2
    | AppRCtx v1 => App (# v1) e
    | LetInCtx e2 => LetIn e e2
    | SeqCtx e2 => Seq e e2
    | TAppCtx => TApp e
    | TLAppCtx => TLApp e
    | BinOpLCtx op e2 => BinOp op e e2
    | BinOpRCtx op v1 => BinOp op (# v1) e
    | IfCtx e1 e2 => If e e1 e2
    | PairLCtx e2 => Pair e e2
    | PairRCtx v1 => Pair (# v1) e
    | InjLCtx => InjL e | InjRCtx => InjR e
    | Proj1Ctx => Proj1 e | Proj2Ctx => Proj2 e
    | CaseCtx e1 e2 => Case e e1 e2
    | AllocCtx => Alloc e
    | LoadCtx => Load e
    | StoreLCtx e2 => Store e e2
    | StoreRCtx v1 => Store (# v1) e
    | FoldCtx => Fold e
    | UnfoldCtx => Unfold e
    | PackCtx => Pack e
    | UnpackCtx e' => Unpack e e'
    end.

Definition state : Type := gmap loc val.

Inductive head_step : expr → state → list Empty_set → expr → state → list expr → Prop :=

  | BetaS e1 e2 v2 σ :
      to_val e2 = Some v2 →
      head_step (App (Lam e1) e2) σ [] e1.[e2/] σ []

  | TBeta e σ :
      head_step (TApp (TLam e)) σ [] e σ []

  | LetInBetaS e1 e2 v2 σ :
      to_val e1 = Some v2 →
      head_step (LetIn e1 e2) σ [] e2.[e1/] σ []

  | SeqBetaS e1 e2 v2 σ :
      to_val e1 = Some v2 →
      head_step (Seq e1 e2) σ [] e2 σ []

  | LBeta e σ :
      head_step (TLApp (TLLam e)) σ [] e σ []

  | BinOpS op n1 n2 σ :
      head_step (BinOp op (Nat n1) (Nat n2)) σ [] (# (binop_eval op n1 n2)) σ []

  | IfFalseS e1 e2 σ :
      head_step (If (Bool false) e1 e2) σ [] e2 σ []
  | IfTrueS e1 e2 σ :
      head_step (If (Bool true) e1 e2) σ [] e1 σ []

  | Proj1S e1 e2 v1 v2 σ :
      to_val e1 = Some v1 →
      to_val e2 = Some v2 →
      head_step (Proj1 $ Pair e1 e2) σ [] (of_val v1) σ []
  | Proj2S e1 e2 v1 v2 σ :
      to_val e1 = Some v1 →
      to_val e2 = Some v2 →
      head_step (Proj2 $ Pair e1 e2) σ [] (of_val v2) σ []

  | CaseLS e0 e1 e2 v0 σ :
      to_val e0 = Some v0 →
      head_step (Case (InjL e0) e1 e2) σ [] (e1.[e0/]) σ []
  | CaseRS e0 e1 e2 v0 σ :
      to_val e0 = Some v0 →
      head_step (Case (InjR e0) e1 e2) σ [] (e2.[e0/]) σ []

  | AllocS e v l σ :
      to_val e = Some v →
      σ !! l = None →
      head_step (Alloc e) σ [] (Loc l) (<[l := v]>σ) []
  | StoreS e v l σ :
      to_val e = Some v →
      is_Some $ σ !! l →
      head_step (Store (Loc l) e) σ [] Unit (<[l := v]>σ) []
  | LoadS l v σ :
      σ !! l = Some v →
      head_step (Load $ Loc l) σ [] (of_val v) σ []

  | UnpackPackS e1 e2 v1 σ :
      to_val e1 = Some v1 →
      head_step (Unpack (Pack e1) e2) σ [] (e2.[e1/]) σ []

  | UnfoldFoldS e v σ :
      to_val e = Some v →
      head_step (Unfold (Fold e)) σ [] e σ []
  .

(* The Iris evaluation-context construction specialized to lambda_sec. *)
Definition fill (K : list ectx_item) (e : expr) : expr :=
  foldl (flip fill_item) e K.

Inductive prim_step (e1 : expr) (σ1 : state) (κ : list Empty_set)
    (e2 : expr) (σ2 : state) (efs : list expr) : Prop :=
| Ectx_step K e1' e2' :
    e1 = fill K e1' → e2 = fill K e2' →
    head_step e1' σ1 κ e2' σ2 efs →
    prim_step e1 σ1 κ e2 σ2 efs.

Notation pstep := (λ x1 x2, prim_step (fst x1) (snd x1) [] (fst x2) (snd x2) []).

End lambda_sec.

Export lambda_sec.

Definition is_atomic (e : expr) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | Alloc e => is_Some (to_val e)
  | Load e =>  is_Some (to_val e)
  | Store e1 e2 => is_Some (to_val e1) ∧ is_Some (to_val e2)
  | _ => False
  end.

=====LATTICE=====
From Coq.ssr Require Import ssreflect.

From stdpp Require Import base prelude list gmap.

Class Lattice (A : Type) := {
    lat_equiv :> Equiv A;
    lat_equiv_equiv :> Equivalence lat_equiv;
    lat_equiv_dec :> RelDecision lat_equiv;
    join : A → A → A;
    join_proper :> Proper ((≡) ==> (≡) ==> (≡)) join;
    join_commutative :> Comm (≡) join;
    join_associative :> Assoc (≡) join;
    join_idempotent  :> IdemP (≡) join;

    bot : A;
    bot_left_id  :> LeftId (≡) bot join;
    bot_right_id :> RightId (≡) bot join;

    top : A;
    top_left_absorb :> LeftAbsorb (≡) top join;
    top_right_absorb :> RightAbsorb (≡) top join;
}.

#[global] Existing Instance lat_equiv.

Class SecurityLattice (label : Type) := {
   lattice :> Lattice label;
   ζ : label;
}.

#[global] Existing Instance lattice.

Infix "⊔" := join (at level 50) : stdpp_scope.

Notation "⊥" := bot : stdpp_scope.

Notation "⊤" := top : stdpp_scope.

Section Order.

Context `{lattice : Lattice label}.

Implicit Types a b : label.

Definition order a b := a ⊔ b ≡ b.

End Order.

Notation "a ⊑ b" := (order a b) (at level 70) : stdpp_scope.

Notation "a ⋢ b" := (¬ (order a b)) (at level 70) : stdpp_scope.

Section Lemmas.

Context `{lattice : Lattice label}.

Implicit Types ℓ : label.

End Lemmas.
=====TYPES=====
From Autosubst Require Export Autosubst.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang lattice.

Section syntactic_flowsto.

Inductive label_term `{SecurityLattice label} :=
  | LVar (x : var)
  | LJoin (l l' : label_term)
  | LLabel (ℓ : label).

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Global Instance label_term_ids : Ids label_term := ltac:(derive).
Global Instance label_term_rename : Rename label_term := ltac:(derive).
Global Instance label_term_subst : Subst label_term := ltac:(derive).

Inductive flowsto : label_term → label_term  → Prop :=
  | FRefl l :
      flowsto l l
  | FTrans l1 l2 l3 :
      flowsto l1 l2 →
      flowsto l2 l3 →
      flowsto l1 l3
  | FBottom l :
      flowsto (LLabel ⊥) l
  | FTop l :
      flowsto l (LLabel ⊤)
  | FLabel ℓ1 ℓ2 :
      ℓ1 ⊑ ℓ2 →
      flowsto (LLabel ℓ1) (LLabel ℓ2)
  | FJoin l1 l2 l3 :
      flowsto l1 l3 →
      flowsto l2 l3 →
      flowsto (LJoin l1 l2) l3.

End syntactic_flowsto.

Notation "a ⊑ₛ b" := (flowsto a b) (at level 70) : stdpp_scope.

Infix "⊔ₛ" := (LJoin) (at level 50) : stdpp_scope.

Notation "⊥ₛ" := (LLabel bot) : stdpp_scope.

Notation "⊤ₛ" := (LLabel top) : stdpp_scope.

Section lambda_sec_types.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Inductive type :=
  | TUnit
  | TBool
  | TNat
  | TVar (x : var)
  | TRef (τ : sectype)
  | TArrow (ℓₑ : label_term) (τ1 τ2 : sectype)
  | TProd (τ1 τ2 : sectype)
  | TSum (τ1 τ2 : sectype)
  | TForall (ℓₑ : label_term) (τ : sectype)
  | TLForall (ℓₑ : label_term) (τ : sectype)
  | TExist (τ : sectype)
  | TRec (τ : sectype)
  with sectype :=
  | TSec (ℓ : label_term) (t : type).

Global Instance Ids_type : Ids type := ltac:(derive).
Global Instance Ids_sectype : Ids sectype := λ n, TSec ⊥ₛ TUnit.

Implicit Types t : type.

Implicit Types τ : sectype.

Scheme type_mut := Induction for type Sort Prop
    with sectype_mut := Induction for sectype Sort Prop.

Notation "t @ ℓ" := (TSec ℓ t) (at level 40).

Fixpoint hsubst_label_type (sigma : var → label_term) (t : type) : type :=
    let _ := hsubst_label_sectype : HSubst label_term sectype in
    match t with
    | TUnit
    | TBool | TNat => t
    | TVar x => TVar x
    | TRef τ => TRef (hsubst sigma τ)
    | TArrow ℓ' τ1 τ2 => TArrow ℓ'.[sigma] (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TProd τ1 τ2 => TProd (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TSum τ1 τ2 => TSum (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TForall ℓ τ => TForall ℓ.[sigma] (hsubst sigma τ)
    | TLForall ℓ τ => TLForall ℓ.[up sigma] (hsubst (up sigma) τ)
    | TExist τ => TExist (hsubst sigma τ)
    | TRec τ => TRec (hsubst sigma τ)
    end
  with hsubst_label_sectype (sigma : var → label_term) (τ : sectype) : sectype :=
    let _ := hsubst_label_type : HSubst label_term type in
    match τ with
    | t @ ℓ => (hsubst sigma t) @ ℓ.[sigma]
    end.

Global Instance HSubst_label_type : HSubst label_term type := hsubst_label_type.
Global Instance HSubst_label_sectype : HSubst label_term sectype := hsubst_label_sectype.

Fixpoint rename_type (xi : var → var) (t : type) : type :=
    let _ := rename_sectype : Rename sectype in
    match t with
    | TUnit
    | TBool | TNat => t
    | TVar x => TVar (xi x)
    | TRef τ => TRef (rename xi τ)
    | TArrow ℓ' τ1 τ2 => TArrow ℓ' (rename xi τ1) (rename xi τ2)
    | TProd τ1 τ2 => TProd (rename xi τ1) (rename xi τ2)
    | TSum τ1 τ2 => TSum (rename xi τ1) (rename xi τ2)
    | TForall ℓ τ => TForall ℓ (rename (upren xi) τ)
    | TLForall ℓ τ => TLForall ℓ (rename xi τ)
    | TExist τ => TExist (rename (upren xi) τ)
    | TRec τ => TRec (rename (upren xi) τ)
    end
  with rename_sectype (xi : var → var) (τ : sectype) : sectype :=
    let _ := rename_type : Rename type in
    match τ with
    | t @ ℓ => (rename xi t) @ ℓ
    end.

Global Instance Rename_type : Rename type := rename_type.
Global Instance Rename_sectype : Rename sectype := rename_sectype.

Fixpoint subst_type (sigma : var → type) (t : type) : type :=
    let _ := hsubst_sectype : HSubst type sectype in
    match t with
    | TUnit
    | TBool | TNat => t
    | TVar x => sigma x
    | TRef τ => TRef (hsubst sigma τ)
    | TArrow ℓ' τ1 τ2 => TArrow ℓ' (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TProd τ1 τ2 => TProd (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TSum τ1 τ2 => TSum (hsubst sigma τ1) (hsubst sigma τ2)
    | TForall ℓ τ => TForall ℓ (hsubst (up sigma) τ)
    | TLForall ℓ τ => TLForall ℓ (hsubst (sigma >>| ren (+1)) τ)
    | TExist τ => TExist (hsubst (up sigma) τ)
    | TRec τ => TRec (hsubst (up sigma) τ)
    end
  with hsubst_sectype (sigma : var → type) (τ : sectype) : sectype :=
    let _ := subst_type : Subst type in
    match τ with
    | t @ ℓ => (subst sigma t) @ ℓ
    end.

Global Instance Subst_type : Subst type := subst_type.
Global Instance HSubst_type : HSubst type sectype := hsubst_sectype.

End lambda_sec_types.

Notation "τ @ ℓ" := (TSec ℓ τ) (at level 60).
=====TYPING=====
From Autosubst Require Export Autosubst.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang lattice types.

Section lambda_sec_typing.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Inductive subtype : type → type → Prop :=
  | TSubRefl t :
      subtype t t
  | TSubTrans t1 t2 t3 :
      subtype t1 t2 → subtype t2 t3 → subtype t1 t3
  | TArrowSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
      secsubtype τ1' τ1 →
      secsubtype τ2 τ2' →
      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
      subtype (TArrow ℓₑ1 τ1 τ2) (TArrow ℓₑ2 τ1' τ2')
  | TForallSub τ1 τ2 ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
      secsubtype τ1 τ2 →
      subtype (TForall ℓₑ1 τ1) (TForall ℓₑ2 τ2)
  | TLForallSub τ1 τ2 ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
      secsubtype τ1 τ2 →
      subtype (TLForall ℓₑ1 τ1) (TLForall ℓₑ2 τ2)
  | TProdSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
      secsubtype τ1 τ1' → secsubtype τ2 τ2' → subtype (TProd τ1 τ2) (TProd τ1' τ2')
  | TSumSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
      secsubtype τ1 τ1' → secsubtype τ2 τ2' → subtype (TSum τ1 τ2) (TSum τ1' τ2')

  | TRecSub τ1 τ2 :


      secsubtype τ1.|[TRec τ1/] τ2.|[TRec τ2/] →
      subtype (TRec τ1) (TRec τ2)
  with secsubtype :  sectype → sectype → Prop :=
  | TSubsec (ℓ ℓ' : label_term) (t t' : type) :
      ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓ' → subtype t t' → secsubtype (t @ ℓ) (t' @ ℓ').

Scheme subtype_mut := Induction for subtype Sort Prop
    with secsubtype_mut := Induction for secsubtype Sort Prop.

Notation "t1 '<:' t2" := (subtype t1 t2) (at level 70).

Notation "τ1 '<:ₛ' τ2" := (secsubtype τ1 τ2) (at level 70).

Definition type_flowsto τ ℓ :=
    let: t @ ℓ' := τ in ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓ'.

Notation "τ ↘ ℓ" := (type_flowsto τ ℓ) (at level 70).

Definition binop_type (op : binop) : type :=
    match op with
    | Add | Sub | Mult => TNat
    | Eq | Le | Lt => TBool
  end.

Reserved Notation "Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ" (at level 74, e, τ at next level).

Inductive typed (Γ : list sectype) (pc : label_term) : expr → sectype → Prop :=
  | Unit_typed : Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Unit : TUnit @ ⊥ₛ
  | Bool_typed b :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Bool b : TBool @ ⊥ₛ
  | Nat_typed n :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Nat n : TNat @ ⊥ₛ
  | Var_typed x τ :
      Γ !! x = Some τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Var x : τ
  | Lam_typed e ℓₑ τ1 τ2 :
      τ1 :: Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Lam e : (TArrow ℓₑ τ1 τ2) @ ⊥ₛ
  | BinOp_typed e1 e2 op ℓ1 ℓ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : TNat @ ℓ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : TNat @ ℓ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ BinOp op e1 e2 : (binop_type op) @ (ℓ1 ⊔ₛ ℓ2)
  | App_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 ℓ ℓₑ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : (TArrow ℓₑ τ1 τ2) @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ1 →
      τ2 ↘ ℓ →
      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ App e1 e2 : τ2
  | LetIn_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
      τ1 :: Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ LetIn e1 e2 : τ2
  | Seq_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Seq e1 e2 : τ2
  | TLam_typed e τ ℓₑ :
      hsubst_sectype (ren (+1)) <$> Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLam e : (TForall ℓₑ τ) @ ⊥ₛ
  | TApp_typed e τ t' ℓ ℓₑ :
      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ →
      τ.|[t'/] ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : (TForall ℓₑ τ) @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TApp e : τ.|[t'/]
  | TLLam_typed e τ ℓₑ :
      hsubst_label_sectype (ren (+1)) <$> Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLLam e : (TLForall ℓₑ τ) @ ⊥ₛ
  | TLApp_typed e τ (ℓ ℓ' ℓₑ : label_term) :
      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ.[ℓ'/] →
      τ.|[ℓ'/] ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : (TLForall ℓₑ τ) @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLApp e : τ.|[ℓ'/]
  | Cond_typed e e1 e2 τ ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TBool @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e1 : τ →
      Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
      τ ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ If e e1 e2 : τ
  | Pair_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Pair e1 e2 : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
  | Proj1_typed e τ1 τ2 ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
      τ1 ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Proj1 e : τ1
  | Proj2_typed e τ1 τ2 ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
      τ2 ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Proj2 e : τ2
  | InjL_typed e τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ InjL e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
  | InjR_typed e τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ InjR e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
  | Case_typed e e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
       τ1 :: Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e1 : τ →
       τ2 :: Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
      τ ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Case e e1 e2 : τ
  | Alloc_typed e τ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ →
      τ ↘ pc →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Alloc e : TRef τ @ ⊥ₛ
  | Store_typed e1 e2 τ ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : TRef τ @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
      τ ↘ pc ⊔ₛ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Store e1 e2 : TUnit @ ⊥ₛ
  | Load_typed e τ τ' ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TRef τ @ ℓ →
      τ <:ₛ τ' →
      τ' ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Load e : τ'
  | TPack e τ t :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ.|[t/] →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Pack e : TExist τ @ ⊥ₛ
  | TUnpack e1 e2 τ1 τ2 ℓ :
      τ2 ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : TExist τ1 @ ℓ →
      τ1 :: (hsubst_sectype (ren (+1)) <$> Γ) # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e2 : (hsubst_sectype (ren (+1)) τ2) →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Unpack e1 e2 : τ2
  | TFold e τ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ.|[TRec τ/] →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Fold e : TRec τ @ ⊥ₛ
  | TUnfold e τ ℓ :
      τ.|[TRec τ/] ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TRec τ @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Unfold e : τ.|[TRec τ/]
  | Sub_typed e τ τ' pc' :
      Γ # pc' ⊢ₜ e : τ' →
      pc ⊑ₛ pc' →
      τ' <:ₛ τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ
  where "Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ" := (typed Γ pc e τ).

Fixpoint env_subst (vs : list val) : var → expr :=
    match vs with
    | [] => ids
    | v :: vs' => #v .: env_subst vs'
    end.

From stdpp Require Import relations.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang typing.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.

Section soundness.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Order facts for the security lattice.                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Local Instance lat_equiv_refl : Reflexive (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact R. Qed.
Local Instance lat_equiv_sym : Symmetric (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact S. Qed.
Local Instance lat_equiv_trans : Transitive (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact T. Qed.

Lemma join_congr : forall a a' b b' : label, a ≡ a' -> b ≡ b' -> a ⊔ b ≡ a' ⊔ b'.
Proof. intros. eapply (@join_proper label _). eauto. eauto. Qed.

Lemma order_join_l : forall a b : label, a ⊑ a ⊔ b.
Proof.
  intros a b. unfold order.
  transitivity ((a ⊔ a) ⊔ b).
  - apply (@join_associative label _ a a b).
  - apply join_congr. apply (@join_idempotent label _ a). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma order_join_r : forall a b : label, b ⊑ a ⊔ b.
Proof.
  intros a b. unfold order.
  transitivity (b ⊔ (b ⊔ a)).
  - apply join_congr. reflexivity. apply (@join_commutative label _ a b).
  - transitivity ((b ⊔ b) ⊔ a).
    + apply (@join_associative label _ b b a).
    + transitivity (b ⊔ a).
      * apply join_congr. apply (@join_idempotent label _ b). reflexivity.
      * apply (@join_commutative label _ b a).
Qed.

Lemma order_refl : forall a : label, a ⊑ a.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@join_idempotent label _ a). Qed.

Lemma order_trans : forall a b c : label, a ⊑ b -> b ⊑ c -> a ⊑ c.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. unfold order in *.
  transitivity (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)).
  - apply join_congr. reflexivity. symmetry. exact Hbc.
  - transitivity ((a ⊔ b) ⊔ c).
    + apply (@join_associative label _ a b c).
    + transitivity (b ⊔ c).
      * apply join_congr. exact Hab. reflexivity.
      * exact Hbc.
Qed.

Lemma order_join_lub : forall a b c : label, a ⊑ c -> b ⊑ c -> a ⊔ b ⊑ c.
Proof.
  intros a b c Ha Hb. unfold order in *.
  transitivity (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)).
  - symmetry. apply (@join_associative label _ a b c).
  - transitivity (a ⊔ c).
    + apply join_congr. reflexivity. exact Hb.
    + exact Ha.
Qed.

Lemma order_bot : forall a : label, ⊥ ⊑ a.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@bot_left_id label _ a). Qed.

Lemma order_top : forall a : label, a ⊑ ⊤.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@top_right_absorb label _ a). Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Label-term semantics and soundness of the syntactic flow relation.  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint interp_label (rho : var -> label) (l : label_term) : label :=
  match l with
  | LVar x => rho x
  | LJoin a b => interp_label rho a ⊔ interp_label rho b
  | LLabel x => x
  end.

Lemma interp_label_subst (rho : var -> label) (sigma : var -> label_term)
    (l : label_term) :
  interp_label rho l.[sigma] = interp_label (fun x => interp_label rho (sigma x)) l.
Proof. induction l; simpl; f_equal; assumption. Qed.

Lemma interp_label_ren (rho : var -> label) (xi : var -> var) (l : label_term) :
  interp_label rho l.[ren xi] = interp_label (fun x => rho (xi x)) l.
Proof. induction l; simpl; f_equal; assumption. Qed.

Lemma flowsto_sound (rho : var -> label) (l1 l2 : label_term) :
  l1 ⊑ₛ l2 -> interp_label rho l1 ⊑ interp_label rho l2.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl.
  - apply order_refl.
  - eapply order_trans; eauto.
  - apply order_bot.
  - apply order_top.
  - assumption.
  - apply order_join_lub; assumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Expression substitution lemmas (Autosubst).                         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Global Instance SubstLemmas_expr_inst : SubstLemmas expr := ltac:(derive).

Lemma expr_subst_comp (e : expr) (sigma tau : var -> expr) :
  e.[sigma].[tau] = e.[sigma >> tau].
Proof. apply subst_comp. Qed.

Lemma expr_subst_id (e : expr) : e.[ids] = e.
Proof. apply subst_id. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Filling evaluation contexts.                                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma fill_nil (e : expr) : fill [] e = e.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fill_cons (Ki : ectx_item) (K : list ectx_item) (e : expr) :
  fill (Ki :: K) e = fill K (fill_item Ki e).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fill_app (K1 K2 : list ectx_item) (e : expr) :
  fill (K1 ++ K2) e = fill K2 (fill K1 e).
Proof.
  revert e. induction K1; intros e; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHK1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Theorem soundness_tini (e : expr) v1 v2 v1' v2' ℓ ℓ' :
    ℓ' ⋢ ζ →
    ℓ  ⊑ ζ →
    [TBool @ (LLabel ℓ')] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ e : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ) →
    [] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ #v1 : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ') →
    [] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ #v2 : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ') →
    ((∃ σ1, rtc pstep (e.[# v1/], ∅) (# v1', σ1)) ∧
     (∃ σ2, rtc pstep (e.[# v2/], ∅) (# v2', σ2))) →
    v1' = v2'.
Proof.
  intros Hhigh Hlow He Hv1 Hv2 Hrun.
Abort.

End soundness.

# 155 — Lambda-sec: termination-insensitive noninterference

## Task

Show that two terminating Lambda-sec runs with the given low-observable Boolean result agree even when their high-security Boolean arguments differ.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: `rocq-stdpp.1.13.0` and Autosubst 1.9.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.

From stdpp Require Import relations.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang typing.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.

Section soundness.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Order facts for the security lattice.                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Local Instance lat_equiv_refl : Reflexive (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact R. Qed.
Local Instance lat_equiv_sym : Symmetric (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact S. Qed.
Local Instance lat_equiv_trans : Transitive (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact T. Qed.

Lemma join_congr : forall a a' b b' : label, a ≡ a' -> b ≡ b' -> a ⊔ b ≡ a' ⊔ b'.
Proof. intros. eapply (@join_proper label _). eauto. eauto. Qed.

Lemma order_join_l : forall a b : label, a ⊑ a ⊔ b.
Proof.
  intros a b. unfold order.
  transitivity ((a ⊔ a) ⊔ b).
  - apply (@join_associative label _ a a b).
  - apply join_congr. apply (@join_idempotent label _ a). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma order_join_r : forall a b : label, b ⊑ a ⊔ b.
Proof.
  intros a b. unfold order.
  transitivity (b ⊔ (b ⊔ a)).
  - apply join_congr. reflexivity. apply (@join_commutative label _ a b).
  - transitivity ((b ⊔ b) ⊔ a).
    + apply (@join_associative label _ b b a).
    + transitivity (b ⊔ a).
      * apply join_congr. apply (@join_idempotent label _ b). reflexivity.
      * apply (@join_commutative label _ b a).
Qed.

Lemma order_refl : forall a : label, a ⊑ a.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@join_idempotent label _ a). Qed.

Lemma order_trans : forall a b c : label, a ⊑ b -> b ⊑ c -> a ⊑ c.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. unfold order in *.
  transitivity (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)).
  - apply join_congr. reflexivity. symmetry. exact Hbc.
  - transitivity ((a ⊔ b) ⊔ c).
    + apply (@join_associative label _ a b c).
    + transitivity (b ⊔ c).
      * apply join_congr. exact Hab. reflexivity.
      * exact Hbc.
Qed.

Lemma order_join_lub : forall a b c : label, a ⊑ c -> b ⊑ c -> a ⊔ b ⊑ c.
Proof.
  intros a b c Ha Hb. unfold order in *.
  transitivity (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)).
  - symmetry. apply (@join_associative label _ a b c).
  - transitivity (a ⊔ c).
    + apply join_congr. reflexivity. exact Hb.
    + exact Ha.
Qed.

Lemma order_bot : forall a : label, ⊥ ⊑ a.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@bot_left_id label _ a). Qed.

Lemma order_top : forall a : label, a ⊑ ⊤.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@top_right_absorb label _ a). Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Label-term semantics and soundness of the syntactic flow relation.  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint interp_label (rho : var -> label) (l : label_term) : label :=
  match l with
  | LVar x => rho x
  | LJoin a b => interp_label rho a ⊔ interp_label rho b
  | LLabel x => x
  end.

Lemma interp_label_subst (rho : var -> label) (sigma : var -> label_term)
    (l : label_term) :
  interp_label rho l.[sigma] = interp_label (fun x => interp_label rho (sigma x)) l.
Proof. induction l; simpl; f_equal; assumption. Qed.

Lemma interp_label_ren (rho : var -> label) (xi : var -> var) (l : label_term) :
  interp_label rho l.[ren xi] = interp_label (fun x => rho (xi x)) l.
Proof. induction l; simpl; f_equal; assumption. Qed.

Lemma flowsto_sound (rho : var -> label) (l1 l2 : label_term) :
  l1 ⊑ₛ l2 -> interp_label rho l1 ⊑ interp_label rho l2.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl.
  - apply order_refl.
  - eapply order_trans; eauto.
  - apply order_bot.
  - apply order_top.
  - assumption.
  - apply order_join_lub; assumption.
Qed.

(* The observer-visible (low) labels. *)
Definition obs (l : label) : Prop := l ⊑ ζ.

Lemma obs_bot : obs ⊥.
Proof. unfold obs. apply order_bot. Qed.

Lemma obs_join : forall a b, obs a -> obs b -> obs (a ⊔ b).
Proof. intros a b Ha Hb. unfold obs in *. apply order_join_lub; assumption. Qed.

Lemma obs_of_low : forall a, a ⊑ ζ -> obs a.
Proof. intros a Ha. exact Ha. Qed.

Lemma obs_under_flow : forall a b, obs a -> a ⊑ b -> b ⊑ ζ -> obs b.
Proof. intros a b Ha Hab Hb. exact Hb. Qed.

Lemma high_not_below_low (a b : label) :
  a ⋢ ζ -> b ⊑ ζ -> a ⋢ b.
Proof.
  intros Ha Hb Hab.
  apply Ha. eapply order_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Definition sectype_label (tau : sectype) : label_term :=
  let: t @ l := tau in l.

Lemma sectype_label_hsubst_label (sigma : var -> label_term) (tau : sectype) :
  sectype_label (hsubst_label_sectype sigma tau) = (sectype_label tau).[sigma].
Proof. destruct tau. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sectype_label_hsubst_type (sigma : var -> type) (tau : sectype) :
  sectype_label (hsubst_sectype sigma tau) = sectype_label tau.
Proof. destruct tau. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sectype_label_rename (xi : var -> var) (tau : sectype) :
  sectype_label (rename_sectype xi tau) = sectype_label tau.
Proof. destruct tau. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma type_flowsto_sound (rho : var -> label) (tau : sectype) (l : label_term) :
  tau ↘ l -> interp_label rho l ⊑ interp_label rho (sectype_label tau).
Proof.
  destruct tau as [t l0]. simpl. intro Hf.
  apply flowsto_sound. exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma secsubtype_label_flow (t : type) (l : label_term) (t' : type) (l' : label_term) :
  secsubtype (t @ l) (t' @ l') -> l ⊑ₛ l'.
Proof.
  intro Hs. inversion Hs as [l0 l1 t0 t1 Hflow Hsub]; subst. exact Hflow.
Qed.

Lemma secsubtype_label_sound (rho : var -> label) (t : type) (l : label_term)
    (t' : type) (l' : label_term) :
  secsubtype (t @ l) (t' @ l') -> interp_label rho l ⊑ interp_label rho l'.
Proof. intros Hs. apply flowsto_sound. apply secsubtype_label_flow in Hs. exact Hs. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Inversion of subtyping at base types.                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma subtype_bool_source (t1 t2 : type) :
  subtype t1 t2 -> t2 = TBool -> t1 = TBool.
Proof.
  intros Hs. induction Hs; intros Heq; try discriminate; try exact Heq;
  try reflexivity; try (subst; eauto).
Qed.

Lemma subtype_bool_target (t1 t2 : type) :
  subtype t1 t2 -> t1 = TBool -> t2 = TBool.
Proof.
  intros Hs. induction Hs; intros Heq; try discriminate; try exact Heq;
  try reflexivity; try (subst; eauto).
Qed.

Lemma secsubtype_bool_target (t : type) (l l' : label_term) :
  secsubtype (t @ l) (TBool @ l') -> t = TBool.
Proof.
  intro Hs. inversion Hs as [l0 l1 t0 t1 Hflow Hsub]; subst.
  eapply subtype_bool_source; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma secsubtype_bool_source (t : type) (l l' : label_term) :
  secsubtype (TBool @ l) (t @ l') -> t = TBool.
Proof.
  intro Hs. inversion Hs as [l0 l1 t0 t1 Hflow Hsub]; subst.

Qed.

(* Expression substitution lemmas (Autosubst).                         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma expr_subst_comp (e : expr) (sigma tau : var -> expr) :
  e.[sigma].[tau] = e.[sigma >> tau].
Proof. apply subst_comp. Qed.

Lemma expr_subst_id (e : expr) : e.[ids] = e.
Proof. apply subst_id. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Basic facts about values.                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma to_val_of_val (v : val) : to_val (of_val v) = Some v.
Proof.
  induction v; simpl; auto;
  try (rewrite IHv; reflexivity);
  try (rewrite IHv1, IHv2; reflexivity).
Qed.

Lemma of_val_to_val (e : expr) (v : val) : to_val e = Some v -> of_val v = e.
Proof.
  revert v. induction e; intros w Ht; simpl in Ht; try discriminate;
  try (injection Ht as <-; reflexivity).
  - destruct (to_val e1) as [v1|] eqn:E1; try discriminate.
    destruct (to_val e2) as [v2|] eqn:E2; try discriminate.
    injection Ht as <-. simpl. f_equal.
    + apply (IHe1 v1 eq_refl).
    + apply (IHe2 v2 eq_refl).
  - destruct (to_val e) as [v0|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
    injection Ht as <-. simpl. f_equal. apply (IHe v0 eq_refl).
  - destruct (to_val e) as [v0|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
    injection Ht as <-. simpl. f_equal. apply (IHe v0 eq_refl).
  - destruct (to_val e) as [v0|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
    injection Ht as <-. simpl. f_equal. apply (IHe v0 eq_refl).
  - destruct (to_val e) as [v0|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
    injection Ht as <-. simpl. f_equal. apply (IHe v0 eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma of_val_inj (v1 v2 : val) : of_val v1 = of_val v2 -> v1 = v2.
Proof.
  revert v2. induction v1; destruct v2; simpl; intros Heq; try discriminate;
  try reflexivity;
  try (injection Heq as <-; reflexivity);
  try (injection Heq as ? ?; subst; f_equal; eauto).

Qed.

(* Filling evaluation contexts.                                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma fill_nil (e : expr) : fill [] e = e.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fill_cons (Ki : ectx_item) (K : list ectx_item) (e : expr) :
  fill (Ki :: K) e = fill K (fill_item Ki e).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fill_app (K1 K2 : list ectx_item) (e : expr) :
  fill (K1 ++ K2) e = fill K2 (fill K1 e).
Proof.
  revert e. induction K1; intros e; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHK1. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** This file collects definitions and theorems on abstract rewriting systems.
These are particularly useful as we define the operational semantics as a
small step semantics. *)
From stdpp Require Export sets well_founded.
From stdpp Require Import options.

(** * Definitions *)
Section definitions.
  Context `(R : relation A).

  (** An element is reducible if a step is possible. *)
  Definition red (x : A) := ∃ y, R x y.

  (** An element is in normal form if no further steps are possible. *)
  Definition nf (x : A) := ¬red x.

  (** The symmetric closure. *)
  Definition sc : relation A := λ x y, R x y ∨ R y x.

  (** The reflexive transitive closure. *)
  Inductive rtc : relation A :=
    | rtc_refl x : rtc x x
    | rtc_l x y z : R x y → rtc y z → rtc x z.

  (** The reflexive transitive closure for setoids. *)
  Inductive rtcS `{Equiv A} : relation A :=
    | rtcS_refl x y : x ≡ y → rtcS x y
    | rtcS_l x y z : R x y → rtcS y z → rtcS x z.

  (** Reductions of exactly [n] steps. *)
  Inductive nsteps : nat → relation A :=
    | nsteps_O x : nsteps 0 x x
    | nsteps_l n x y z : R x y → nsteps n y z → nsteps (S n) x z.

  (** Reductions of at most [n] steps. *)
  Inductive bsteps : nat → relation A :=
    | bsteps_refl n x : bsteps n x x
    | bsteps_l n x y z : R x y → bsteps n y z → bsteps (S n) x z.

  (** The transitive closure. *)
  Inductive tc : relation A :=
    | tc_once x y : R x y → tc x y
    | tc_l x y z : R x y → tc y z → tc x z.

  (** An element [x] is universally looping if all paths starting at [x]
  are infinite. *)
  CoInductive all_loop : A → Prop :=
    | all_loop_do_step x : red x → (∀ y, R x y → all_loop y) → all_loop x.

  (** An element [x] is existentally looping if some path starting at [x]
  is infinite. *)
  CoInductive ex_loop : A → Prop :=
    | ex_loop_do_step x y : R x y → ex_loop y → ex_loop x.
End definitions.

(** The reflexive transitive symmetric closure. *)
Definition rtsc {A} (R : relation A) := rtc (sc R).

(** Weakly and strongly normalizing elements. *)
Definition wn {A} (R : relation A) (x : A) := ∃ y, rtc R x y ∧ nf R y.

Notation sn R := (Acc (flip R)).

(** The various kinds of "confluence" properties. Any relation that has the
diamond property is confluent, and any confluent relation is locally confluent.
The naming convention are taken from "Term Rewriting and All That" by Baader and
Nipkow. *)
Definition diamond {A} (R : relation A) :=
  ∀ x y1 y2, R x y1 → R x y2 → ∃ z, R y1 z ∧ R y2 z.

Definition confluent {A} (R : relation A) :=
  diamond (rtc R).

Definition locally_confluent {A} (R : relation A) :=
  ∀ x y1 y2, R x y1 → R x y2 → ∃ z, rtc R y1 z ∧ rtc R y2 z.

Definition deterministic {A} (R : relation A) :=
  ∀ x y1 y2, R x y1 → R x y2 → y1 = y2.

Global Hint Unfold nf red : core.

(** * General theorems *)
Section general.
  Context `{R : relation A}.

  Local Hint Constructors rtc nsteps bsteps tc : core.

  (** ** Results about the reflexive-transitive closure [rtc] *)
  Lemma rtc_trans x y z : rtc R x y → rtc R y z → rtc R x z.
  Proof. induction 1; eauto. Qed.

  Global Instance rtc_po : PreOrder (rtc R).
  Proof. split; [exact (@rtc_refl A R) | exact rtc_trans]. Qed.

  Global Instance rtc_equivalence : Symmetric R → Equivalence (rtc R).
  Proof.
    split; try apply _.
    intros x y. induction 1 as [|x1 x2 x3]; [done|trans x2; eauto].
  Qed.

  Lemma rtc_once x y : R x y → rtc R x y.
  Proof. eauto. Qed.
  Lemma rtc_r x y z : rtc R x y → R y z → rtc R x z.
  Proof. intros. etrans; eauto. Qed.
  Lemma rtc_inv x z : rtc R x z → x = z ∨ ∃ y, R x y ∧ rtc R y z.
  Proof. inv 1; eauto. Qed.
  Lemma rtc_ind_l (P : A → Prop) (z : A)
    (Prefl : P z) (Pstep : ∀ x y, R x y → rtc R y z → P y → P x) :
    ∀ x, rtc R x z → P x.
  Proof. induction 1; eauto. Qed.

  Local Lemma rtc_ind_r_weak (P : A → A → Prop)
      (Prefl : ∀ x, P x x)
      (Pstep : ∀ x y z, rtc R x y → R y z → P x y → P x z) :
    ∀ x z, rtc R x z → P x z.
  Proof.
    cut (∀ y z, rtc R y z → ∀ x, rtc R x y → P x y → P x z).
    { eauto using rtc_refl. }
    induction 1; eauto using rtc_r.
  Qed.

4. 2. **Provenance of values must be recursive, not syntactic equality.** Even though the only free variable of `e` is high, low-typed values can contain high payloads (`Pair`, closures, sums). Note values are normal forms (`fill K redex` is never `of_val v`), so the two runs genuinely end at values.

## Recommendation to the coordinator

- The fast path is the operational simulation indexed by the two **given** `rtc` derivations (not a Kripke logrel). The reserved notations `⟦τ⟧`, `⟦τ⟧ₑ`, `⟦Γ⟧*` in `theories/prelude/base.v` indicate the original solution was a step-indexed logrel — reconstructing that is the larger path.
- Since type structure is label-irrelevant, you can safely drop type-substitution lemmas and word the invariant entirely over labels plus a high/low (`obs l := l ⊑ ζ`) classification. The useful verified primitives are in `/tmp/agent/Scratch.v` and `/workspace/Task.v` (order/join lemmas, `flowsto_sound`, `high_not_below_low`, `fill_app` direction, `to_val_of_val`, `of_val_to_val`, `of_val_inj`, `subtype_bool_*`).
- I would not describe this as a short proof: the heap/provenance invariant and the 18 `head_step` × typing-rule case interactions dominate. I could not get a complete proof within this session, and I recommend the parent continue the operational-simulation route rather than attempt a full semantic logrel.

No counterexample exists as far as I can determine; the target is unprovable only in the practical sense that the required metatheory has not been constructed.

From stdpp Require Import relations.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang typing.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.
Section s.
Context `{SecurityLattice label}.
Lemma fill_app (K1 K2 : list ectx_item) (e : expr) :
  fill (K1 ++ K2) e = fill K2 (fill K1 e).
Proof. revert e. induction K1; intros e; simpl; [reflexivity|rewrite IHK1; reflexivity]. Qed.
Lemma prim_step_fill (K : list ectx_item) (e : expr) (σ : state)
    (κ : list Empty_set) (e' : expr) (σ' : state) (efs : list expr) :
  prim_step e σ κ e' σ' efs -> prim_step (fill K e) σ κ (fill K e') σ' efs.
Proof.
  intros Hstep. inversion Hstep.
  eapply Ectx_step with (K := K0 ++ K) (e1' := e1') (e2' := e2').
  - rewrite fill_app. rewrite H0. reflexivity.
  - rewrite fill_app. rewrite H1. reflexivity.
  - exact H2.
Qed.
Lemma pstep_fill (K : list ectx_item) (e : expr) (σ : state) (e' : expr) (σ' : state) :
  pstep (e, σ) (e', σ') -> pstep (fill K e, σ) (fill K e', σ').
Proof. intros Hstep. apply prim_step_fill. exact Hstep. Qed.
Lemma rtc_pstep_fill (K : list ectx_item) (e : expr) (σ : state) (e' : expr) (σ' : state) :
  rtc pstep (e, σ) (e', σ') -> rtc pstep (fill K e, σ) (fill K e', σ').
Proof.
  intros Hr. remember (e,σ) as x eqn:Ex. remember (e',σ') as y eqn:Ey.
  revert e σ e' σ' Ex Ey.
  induction Hr as [x0 | x0 z y0 Hstep Htail IH]; intros e0 σ0 e1 σ1 Ex Ey; subst.
  - apply rtc_refl.
  - destruct z as [ez σz].
    eapply rtc_l.
    + apply pstep_fill. rewrite Ex in Hstep. exact Hstep.
    + apply IH with (e0 := ez) (σ0 := σz) (e1 := e1) (σ1 := σ1); [reflexivity | exact Ey].
Qed.
End s.
EOF

From stdpp Require Import relations.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang typing.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Order and flowsto soundness (standalone copies).                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Section sound.
Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Local Instance lat_equiv_refl : Reflexive (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact R. Qed.
Local Instance lat_equiv_sym : Symmetric (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact S. Qed.
Local Instance lat_equiv_trans : Transitive (@equiv label lattice).
Proof. destruct lat_equiv_equiv as [R S T]. exact T. Qed.

Lemma join_congr : forall a a' b b' : label, a ≡ a' -> b ≡ b' -> a ⊔ b ≡ a' ⊔ b'.
Proof. intros. eapply (@join_proper label _). eauto. eauto. Qed.

Lemma order_refl : forall a : label, a ⊑ a.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@join_idempotent label _ a). Qed.

Lemma order_trans : forall a b c : label, a ⊑ b -> b ⊑ c -> a ⊑ c.
Proof.
  intros a b c Hab Hbc. unfold order in *.
  transitivity (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)).
  - apply join_congr. reflexivity. symmetry. exact Hbc.
  - transitivity ((a ⊔ b) ⊔ c).
    + apply (@join_associative label _ a b c).
    + transitivity (b ⊔ c).
      * apply join_congr. exact Hab. reflexivity.
      * exact Hbc.
Qed.

Lemma order_bot : forall a : label, ⊥ ⊑ a.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@bot_left_id label _ a). Qed.

Lemma order_top : forall a : label, a ⊑ ⊤.
Proof. intros a. unfold order. apply (@top_right_absorb label _ a). Qed.

Lemma order_join_lub : forall a b c : label, a ⊑ c -> b ⊑ c -> a ⊔ b ⊑ c.
Proof.
  intros a b c Ha Hb. unfold order in *.
  transitivity (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)).
  - symmetry. apply (@join_associative label _ a b c).
  - transitivity (a ⊔ c).
    + apply join_congr. reflexivity. exact Hb.
    + exact Ha.
Qed.

Fixpoint interp_label (rho : var -> label) (l : label_term) : label :=
  match l with
  | LVar x => rho x
  | LJoin a b => interp_label rho a ⊔ interp_label rho b
  | LLabel x => x
  end.

Lemma flowsto_sound (rho : var -> label) (l1 l2 : label_term) :
  l1 ⊑ₛ l2 -> interp_label rho l1 ⊑ interp_label rho l2.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl.
  - apply order_refl.
  - eapply order_trans; eauto.
  - apply order_bot.
  - apply order_top.
  - assumption.
  - apply order_join_lub; assumption.
Qed.

End sound.

Section model.

(* Concrete 2-element lattice on bool: false <= true, join = orb. *)
#[local] Instance bool_lattice : Lattice bool := {|
  lat_equiv := eq;
  lat_equiv_equiv := eq_equivalence;
  lat_equiv_dec := fun x y : bool => Bool.bool_dec x y;
  join := orb;

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Section s.

  match l with LVar x => rho x | LJoin a b => interp_label rho a ⊔ interp_label rho b | LLabel x => x end.

Definition obs_dec (l : label) : {l ⊑ ζ} + {~ (l ⊑ ζ)} :=
  match @lat_equiv_dec label lattice (l ⊔ ζ) ζ with
  | left H => left H
  | right H => right H
  end.

(* A world: two heaps and a partial pairing of locations with the content sectype. *)
Definition World := (state * state * (loc -> option (loc * sectype)))%type.
Definition wst1 (W : World) : state := W.1.1.
Definition wst2 (W : World) : state := W.1.2.
Definition wmap (W : World) : loc -> option (loc * sectype) := W.2.

(* Type-variable relations: indexed by label, world, and two values. *)
Definition TyRel := label -> World -> val -> val -> Prop.

Definition tenv := var -> TyRel.

(* strip the Fold constructor at the value level *)
Definition unfold_val (v : val) : val :=
  match v with FoldV v' => v' | v => v end.

(* Fuel-indexed value relation; [le] is the world extension relation. *)
Fixpoint V (k : nat) (rho : var -> label) (Delta : tenv)
    (le : World -> World -> Prop) (W : World) (tau : sectype) (v1 v2 : val) {struct k} : Prop :=
  match k with
  | O => True
  | S k' =>
    (fix Vty (tau : sectype) {struct tau} : val -> val -> Prop :=
       match tau with
       | TSec l t =>
         match obs_dec (interp_label rho l) with
         | right _ => fun _ _ => True
         | left _ =>
           match t with
           | TBool => fun v1 v2 => v1 = v2
           | TNat => fun v1 v2 => v1 = v2
           | TUnit => fun _ _ => True
           | TVar x => fun v1 v2 => Delta x (interp_label rho l) W v1 v2
           | TProd tau1 tau2 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | PairV a1 b1, PairV a2 b2 => Vty tau1 a1 a2 /\ Vty tau2 b1 b2
               | _,_ => False
               end
           | TSum tau1 tau2 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | InjLV a1, InjLV a2 => Vty tau1 a1 a2
               | InjRV a1, InjRV a2 => Vty tau2 a1 a2

               end

               forall (a1 a2 : expr),

                     rtc pstep (a1, wst1 W) (#w1, wst1 W') ->
                     rtc pstep (a2, wst2 W) (#w2, wst2 W') ->
                     @V k' rho Delta le W' tau1 w1 w2) ->

                     @le W W' ->
                     rtc pstep (App (#v1) a1, wst1 W) (#w1, wst1 W') ->
                     rtc pstep (App (#v2) a2, wst2 W) (#w2, wst2 W') ->
                     @V k' rho Delta le W' tau2 w1 w2)
           | TRef tau0 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | LocV l1, LocV l2 =>
                   match wmap W l1 with
                   | Some (l2', tau') => l2' = l2 /\ tau' = tau0 /\
                       (match wst1 W !! l1, wst2 W !! l2 with
                        | Some x1, Some x2 => Vty tau0 x1 x2
                        | _,_ => False end)
                   | None => False
                   end
               | _,_ => False
               end
           | TForall _ tau0 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | TLamV b1, TLamV b2 =>
                   forall (R : TyRel) (W' : World), @le W W' ->
                     forall (w1 w2 : val),
                       rtc pstep (TApp (#v1), wst1 W') (#w1, wst1 W') ->
                       rtc pstep (TApp (#v2), wst2 W') (#w2, wst2 W') ->
                       @V k' rho (fun x => match x with 0 => R | S n => Delta n end) le W' tau0 w1 w2
               | _,_ => False
               end
           | TLForall _ tau0 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | TLLamV b1, TLLamV b2 =>
                   forall (l' : label) (W' : World), @le W W' ->
                     forall (w1 w2 : val),
                       rtc pstep (TLApp (#v1), wst1 W') (#w1, wst1 W') ->
                       rtc pstep (TLApp (#v2), wst2 W') (#w2, wst2 W') ->
                       @V k' (fun x => match x with 0 => l' | S n => rho n end) Delta le W' tau0 w1 w2
               | _,_ => False
               end
           | TExist tau0 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | PackV a1, PackV a2 =>
                   exists (R : TyRel) (W' : World), @le W W' /\
                     @V k' rho (fun x => match x with 0 => R | S n => Delta n end) le W' tau0 a1 a2
               | _,_ => False
               end
           | TRec tau0 => fun v1 v2 =>
               @V k' rho Delta le W (hsubst_sectype (TRec tau0 .: ids) tau0) (unfold_val v1) (unfold_val v2)
           end
         end
       end) tau v1 v2
  end.

End s.
EOF
