From stdpp Require Import relations.
From Stdlib Require Import Wellfounded.Lexicographic_Product Wellfounded.Inverse_Image Arith.Wf_nat.
From Stdlib Require Import Program.Wf.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang typing.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Section s.
Context `{SecurityLattice label}.
Definition fold_content (v:val) : val := match v with FoldV a => a | _ => v end.
Fixpoint size_type (t : type) : nat :=
  match t with
  | TUnit | TBool | TNat | TVar _ => 1
  | TRef τ => S (size_sectype τ)
  | TArrow _ τ1 τ2 => S (size_sectype τ1 + size_sectype τ2)
  | TProd τ1 τ2 => S (size_sectype τ1 + size_sectype τ2)
  | TSum τ1 τ2 => S (size_sectype τ1 + size_sectype τ2)
  | TForall _ τ => S (size_sectype τ)
  | TLForall _ τ => S (size_sectype τ)
  | TExist τ => S (size_sectype τ)
  | TRec τ => S (size_sectype τ)
  end
with size_sectype (τ : sectype) : nat :=
  match τ with TSec _ t => S (size_type t) end.

Inductive mrel : (nat * sectype) -> (nat * sectype) -> Prop :=
| mrel_fuel : forall k1 k2 τ1 τ2, k1 < k2 -> mrel (k1, τ1) (k2, τ2)
| mrel_size : forall k τ1 τ2, size_sectype τ1 < size_sectype τ2 -> mrel (k, τ1) (k, τ2).

Definition rank (p : nat * sectype) : {x : nat & nat} :=
  @existT nat (fun _ => nat) (fst p) (size_sectype (snd p)).
Definition srel (p q : nat * sectype) : Prop :=
  @Relation_Operators.lexprod nat (fun _ => nat) Nat.lt (fun _ => Nat.lt) (rank p) (rank q).
Lemma wf_srel : well_founded srel.
Proof. unfold srel. apply (wf_inverse_image _ _ _ rank). apply wf_lexprod; [apply lt_wf | intro; apply lt_wf]. Qed.
Lemma mrel_sub : forall p q, mrel p q -> srel p q.
Proof.
  intros p q H. induction H.
  - unfold srel, rank. apply Relation_Operators.left_lex. cbn. exact H.
  - unfold srel, rank. apply Relation_Operators.right_lex. cbn. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma wf_sub (A : Type) (R S : A -> A -> Prop) :
  (forall x y, R x y -> S x y) -> well_founded S -> well_founded R.
Proof.
  intros Hsub Hwf x. induction (Hwf x) as [x0 _ IH].
  apply Acc_intro. intros y Hy. apply IH. apply Hsub. exact Hy.
Qed.
Lemma wf_mrel : well_founded mrel.
Proof. apply (wf_sub _ _ _ mrel_sub wf_srel). Qed.

Definition unfold_sectype (τ0 : sectype) : sectype := τ0.

Program Fixpoint V (p : nat * sectype) (v1 v2 : val) {wf mrel p} : Prop :=
  match p with
  | (k, τ) =>
    match k with
    | O => True
    | S k' =>
      match τ with
      | TSec l t =>
        match t with
        | TBool => v1 = v2
        | TArrow _ τ1 τ2 =>
            (forall (s : nat) (Hs : s <= S k'), V (S k' - s, τ1) v1 v2) /\
            (forall (s : nat) (Hs : s <= S k'), V (S k' - s, τ2) v1 v2)
        | TProd τ1 τ2 => V (S k', τ1) v1 v2 /\ V (S k', τ2) v1 v2
        | TRec τ0 => V (k', unfold_sectype τ0) (fold_content v1) (fold_content v2)
        | _ => True
        end
      end
    end
  end.
Next Obligation.
  destruct s.
  - apply mrel_size. cbn. lia.
  - apply mrel_fuel. cbn. lia.
Qed.
Next Obligation.
  destruct s.
  - apply mrel_size. cbn. lia.
  - apply mrel_fuel. cbn. lia.
Qed.
Next Obligation. apply mrel_size. cbn. lia. Qed.
Next Obligation. apply mrel_size. cbn. lia. Qed.
Next Obligation. apply mrel_fuel. cbn. lia. Qed.
Check V.
Print Assumptions V.
End s.
EOF

From stdpp Require Import relations.
From Stdlib Require Import Wellfounded.Lexicographic_Product Wellfounded.Inverse_Image Arith.Wf_nat.
From Stdlib Require Import Program.Wf.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang typing.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Section s.
Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

(* exact-step closure *)
Inductive steps : nat -> (expr * state) -> (expr * state) -> Prop :=
| steps_0 : forall x, steps 0 x x
| steps_S : forall n x y z, pstep x y -> steps n y z -> steps (S n) x z.

(* sizes for the lexicographic fuel/type measure *)
Fixpoint size_type (t : type) : nat :=
  match t with
  | TUnit => 1 | TBool => 1 | TNat => 1 | TVar _ => 1
  | TRef τ => S (size_sectype τ)
  | TArrow _ τ1 τ2 => S (size_sectype τ1 + size_sectype τ2)
  | TProd τ1 τ2 => S (size_sectype τ1 + size_sectype τ2)
  | TSum τ1 τ2 => S (size_sectype τ1 + size_sectype τ2)
  | TForall _ τ => S (size_sectype τ)
  | TLForall _ τ => S (size_sectype τ)
  | TExist τ => S (size_sectype τ)
  | TRec τ => S (size_sectype τ)
  end
with size_sectype (τ : sectype) : nat :=
  match τ with TSec _ t => S (size_type t) end.

Inductive mrel : (nat * sectype) -> (nat * sectype) -> Prop :=
| mrel_fuel : forall k1 k2 τ1 τ2, k1 < k2 -> mrel (k1, τ1) (k2, τ2)
| mrel_size : forall k τ1 τ2, size_sectype τ1 < size_sectype τ2 -> mrel (k, τ1) (k, τ2).

Definition rank (p : nat * sectype) : {x : nat & nat} :=
  @existT nat (fun _ => nat) (fst p) (size_sectype (snd p)).
Definition srel (p q : nat * sectype) : Prop :=
  @Relation_Operators.lexprod nat (fun _ => nat) Nat.lt (fun _ => Nat.lt) (rank p) (rank q).
Lemma wf_srel : well_founded srel.
Proof. unfold srel. apply (wf_inverse_image _ _ _ rank). apply wf_lexprod; [apply lt_wf | intro; apply lt_wf]. Qed.
Lemma mrel_sub : forall p q, mrel p q -> srel p q.
Proof. intros p q Hm. induction Hm as [k1 k2 t1 t2 Hlt | k t1 t2 Hlt].
  - unfold srel, rank. apply Relation_Operators.left_lex. cbn. exact Hlt.
  - unfold srel, rank. apply Relation_Operators.right_lex. cbn. exact Hlt. Qed.
Lemma wf_sub (A : Type) (R S : A -> A -> Prop) :
  (forall x y, R x y -> S x y) -> well_founded S -> well_founded R.
Proof. intros Hsub Hwf x. induction (Hwf x) as [x0 _ IH].
  apply Acc_intro. intros y Hy. apply IH. apply Hsub. exact Hy. Qed.
Lemma wf_mrel : well_founded mrel.
Proof. exact (@wf_sub (nat * sectype) mrel srel mrel_sub wf_srel). Qed.

(* worlds and type-relation environments *)
Definition World := (state * state * (loc -> option (loc * sectype)))%type.
Definition wst1 (W : World) : state := W.1.1.
Definition wst2 (W : World) : state := W.1.2.
Definition wmap (W : World) : loc -> option (loc * sectype) := W.2.
Definition TyRel := nat -> label -> World -> val -> val -> Prop.
Definition tenv := var -> TyRel.
Definition up_tenv (R : TyRel) (Delta : tenv) : tenv :=
  fun x => match x with 0 => R | S n => Delta n end.
Definition up_rho (l' : label) (rho : var -> label) : var -> label :=
  fun x => match x with 0 => l' | S n => rho n end.
Definition unfold_val (v : val) : val :=
  match v with FoldV v' => v' | v => v end.

Definition obs_dec (l : label) : {l ⊑ ζ} + {~ (l ⊑ ζ)} :=
  match @lat_equiv_dec label lattice (l ⊔ ζ) ζ with
  | left H => left H
  | right H => right H
  end.

(* Decreasing-call lemmas for the obligations. *)
Lemma mrel_prod_l (k : nat) (l : label_term) (τ1 τ2 : sectype) :
  mrel (S k, τ1) (S k, TSec l (TProd τ1 τ2)).
Proof. apply mrel_size. cbn. lia. Qed.
Lemma mrel_prod_r (k : nat) (l : label_term) (τ1 τ2 : sectype) :
  mrel (S k, τ2) (S k, TSec l (TProd τ1 τ2)).
Proof. apply mrel_size. cbn. lia. Qed.
Lemma mrel_sum_l (k : nat) (l : label_term) (τ1 τ2 : sectype) :
  mrel (S k, τ1) (S k, TSec l (TSum τ1 τ2)).
Proof. apply mrel_size. cbn. lia. Qed.
Lemma mrel_sum_r (k : nat) (l : label_term) (τ1 τ2 : sectype) :
  mrel (S k, τ2) (S k, TSec l (TSum τ1 τ2)).
Proof. apply mrel_size. cbn. lia. Qed.
Lemma mrel_ref (k : nat) (l : label_term) (τ0 : sectype) :
  mrel (S k, τ0) (S k, TSec l (TRef τ0)).
Proof. apply mrel_size. cbn. lia. Qed.
Lemma mrel_exist (k : nat) (l : label_term) (τ0 : sectype) :
  mrel (S k, τ0) (S k, TSec l (TExist τ0)).
Proof. apply mrel_size. cbn. lia. Qed.
Lemma mrel_rec (k : nat) (l : label_term) (τ0 : sectype) :
  mrel (k, hsubst_sectype (TRec τ0 .: ids) τ0) (S k, TSec l (TRec τ0)).
Proof. apply mrel_fuel. lia. Qed.

Lemma mrel_step (k n1 n2 : nat) (l : label_term) (t : type) (τ0 : sectype) :
  n1 + n2 <= S k ->
  size_sectype τ0 < size_sectype (TSec l t) ->
  mrel (S k - (n1 + n2), τ0) (S k, TSec l t).
Proof.
  intros Hle Hsz. destruct (n1 + n2) as [|m].
  - apply mrel_size. cbn in *. lia.
  - apply mrel_fuel. cbn in *. lia.
Qed.

(* The value relation with exact remaining fuel. *)
Program Fixpoint V (p : nat * sectype) (rho : var -> label) (Delta : tenv)
    (le : World -> World -> Prop) (W : World) (v1 v2 : val) {wf mrel p} : Prop :=
  match p with
  | (k, τ) =>
    match k with
    | O => True
    | S k' =>
      match τ with
      | TSec l t =>
        match obs_dec (interp_label rho l) with
        | right _ => True
        | left _ =>
          match t with
          | TBool => v1 = v2
          | TNat => v1 = v2
          | TUnit => True
          | TVar x => Delta (S k') (interp_label rho l) W v1 v2
          | TProd τ1 τ2 =>
              match v1, v2 with
              | PairV a1 b1, PairV a2 b2 =>
                  V (S k', τ1) rho Delta le W a1 a2 /\
                  V (S k', τ2) rho Delta le W b1 b2
              | _,_ => False
              end
          | TSum τ1 τ2 =>
              match v1, v2 with
              | InjLV a1, InjLV a2 => V (S k', τ1) rho Delta le W a1 a2
              | InjRV a1, InjRV a2 => V (S k', τ2) rho Delta le W a1 a2
              | _,_ => False
              end
          | TArrow le0 τ1 τ2 =>
              (forall (a1 a2 : expr),
                 (forall (n1 n2 : nat) (w1 w2 : val) (s1' s2' : state) (W' : World),
                     le W W' -> wst1 W' = s1' -> wst2 W' = s2' ->
                     steps n1 (a1, wst1 W) (#w1, s1') ->
                     steps n2 (a2, wst2 W) (#w2, s2') ->
                     n1 + n2 <= S k' ->
                     V (S k' - (n1 + n2), τ1) rho Delta le W' w1 w2) ->
                 (forall (n1 n2 : nat) (w1 w2 : val) (s1' s2' : state) (W' : World),
                     le W W' -> wst1 W' = s1' -> wst2 W' = s2' ->
                     steps n1 (App (#v1) a1, wst1 W) (#w1, s1') ->
                     steps n2 (App (#v2) a2, wst2 W) (#w2, s2') ->
                     n1 + n2 <= S k' ->
                     V (S k' - (n1 + n2), τ2) rho Delta le W' w1 w2))
          | TRef τ0 =>
              match v1, v2 with
              | LocV l1, LocV l2 =>
                  match wmap W l1 with
                  | Some p' =>
                      let '(l2', τ') := p' in
                      l2' = l2 /\ τ' = τ0 /\
                      (match wst1 W !! l1, wst2 W !! l2 with
                       | Some x1, Some x2 => V (S k', τ0) rho Delta le W x1 x2
                       | _,_ => False
                       end)
                  | None => False
                  end
              | _,_ => False
              end
          | TForall le0 τ0 =>
              match v1, v2 with
              | TLamV b1, TLamV b2 =>
                  forall (R : TyRel) (W' : World), le W W' ->
                    forall (n1 n2 : nat) (w1 w2 : val) (s1' s2' : state) (W'' : World),
                      le W' W'' -> wst1 W'' = s1' -> wst2 W'' = s2' ->
                      steps n1 (TApp (#v1), wst1 W') (#w1, s1') ->
                      steps n2 (TApp (#v2), wst2 W') (#w2, s2') ->
                      n1 + n2 <= S k' ->
                      V (S k' - (n1 + n2), τ0) rho (up_tenv R Delta) le W'' w1 w2
              | _,_ => False
              end
          | TLForall le0 τ0 =>
              match v1, v2 with
              | TLLamV b1, TLLamV b2 =>
                  forall (l' : label) (W' : World), le W W' ->
                    forall (n1 n2 : nat) (w1 w2 : val) (s1' s2' : state) (W'' : World),
                      le W' W'' -> wst1 W'' = s1' -> wst2 W'' = s2' ->
                      steps n1 (TLApp (#v1), wst1 W') (#w1, s1') ->
                      steps n2 (TLApp (#v2), wst2 W') (#w2, s2') ->
                      n1 + n2 <= S k' ->
                      V (S k' - (n1 + n2), τ0) (up_rho l' rho) Delta le W'' w1 w2
              | _,_ => False
              end
          | TExist τ0 =>
              match v1, v2 with
              | PackV a1, PackV a2 =>
                  exists (R : TyRel) (W' : World), le W W' /\
                    V (S k', τ0) rho (up_tenv R Delta) le W' a1 a2
              | _,_ => False
              end
          | TRec τ0 =>
              V (k', hsubst_sectype (TRec τ0 .: ids) τ0) rho Delta le W
                (unfold_val v1) (unfold_val v2)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end.
Next Obligation. intros; subst. apply mrel_prod_l. Qed.
Next Obligation. intros; subst. apply mrel_prod_r. Qed.
Next Obligation. intros; subst. apply mrel_sum_l. Qed.
Next Obligation. intros; subst. apply mrel_sum_r. Qed.
Next Obligation.
  intros; subst. eapply mrel_step; eauto.
Qed.
Next Obligation.
  intros; subst. eapply mrel_step; eauto.
Qed.
Next Obligation. intros; subst. apply mrel_ref. Qed.
Next Obligation.
  intros; subst. eapply mrel_step; eauto.
Qed.
Next Obligation.
  intros; subst. eapply mrel_step; eauto.
Qed.
Next Obligation. intros; subst. apply mrel_exist. Qed.
Next Obligation. intros; subst. apply mrel_rec. Qed.
Next Obligation.
  apply (wf_inverse_image _ _ mrel (fun recarg => projT1 recarg)).
  apply wf_mrel.
Qed.
Check V.
Print Assumptions V.
End s.
EOF

Proof.
  intros Hr. remember (e,σ) as x eqn:Ex. remember (e',σ') as y eqn:Ey.
  revert e σ e' σ' Ex Ey.
  induction Hr as [x0 | x0 z y0 Hstep Htail IH]; intros e0 σ0 e1 σ1 Ex Ey.
  - subst x0. injection Ey as He1 He2. subst. apply rtc_refl.
  - destruct z as [ez σz]. subst x0.
    eapply rtc_l.
    + apply pstep_fill. simpl. exact Hstep.
    + apply (IH ez σz e1 σ1 eq_refl Ey).
Qed.

(**********************************************************************)
(* A semantic model for the calculus: worlds, type-relation            *)
(* environments, and a fuel-indexed value relation.                    *)
(**********************************************************************)

Definition obs_dec (l : label) : {l ⊑ ζ} + {~ (l ⊑ ζ)} :=
  match @lat_equiv_dec label lattice (l ⊔ ζ) ζ with
  | left H => left H
  | right H => right H
  end.

(* A world: two heaps together with a partial pairing of locations,     *)
(* each paired location carrying the sectype of its contents.           *)
Definition World := (state * state * (loc -> option (loc * sectype)))%type.
Definition wst1 (W : World) : state := W.1.1.
Definition wst2 (W : World) : state := W.1.2.
Definition wmap (W : World) : loc -> option (loc * sectype) := W.2.

(* A relation interpreting a type variable, indexed by the label at     *)
(* which it is used, the world, and the two values.                     *)
Definition TyRel := label -> World -> val -> val -> Prop.

Definition tenv := var -> TyRel.

Definition unfold_val (v : val) : val :=
  match v with FoldV v' => v' | v => v end.

Fixpoint V (k : nat) (rho : var -> label) (Delta : tenv)
    (le : World -> World -> Prop) (W : World) (tau : sectype)
    (v1 v2 : val) {struct k} : Prop :=
  match k with
  | O => True
  | S k' =>
    (fix Vty (tau : sectype) {struct tau} : val -> val -> Prop :=
       match tau with
       | TSec l t =>
         match obs_dec (interp_label rho l) with
         | right _ => fun _ _ => True
         | left _ =>
           match t with
           | TBool => fun v1 v2 => v1 = v2
           | TNat => fun v1 v2 => v1 = v2
           | TUnit => fun _ _ => True
           | TVar x => fun v1 v2 => Delta x (interp_label rho l) W v1 v2
           | TProd tau1 tau2 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | PairV a1 b1, PairV a2 b2 => Vty tau1 a1 a2 /\ Vty tau2 b1 b2
               | _,_ => False
               end
           | TSum tau1 tau2 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | InjLV a1, InjLV a2 => Vty tau1 a1 a2
               | InjRV a1, InjRV a2 => Vty tau2 a1 a2
               | _,_ => False
               end
           | TArrow _ tau1 tau2 => fun v1 v2 =>
               forall (a1 a2 : expr),
                 (forall (w1 w2 : val) (W' : World),
                     le W W' ->
                     rtc pstep (a1, wst1 W) (#w1, wst1 W') ->
                     rtc pstep (a2, wst2 W) (#w2, wst2 W') ->
                     V k' rho Delta le W' tau1 w1 w2) ->
                 (forall (w1 w2 : val) (W' : World),
                     le W W' ->
                     rtc pstep (App (#v1) a1, wst1 W) (#w1, wst1 W') ->
                     rtc pstep (App (#v2) a2, wst2 W) (#w2, wst2 W') ->
                     V k' rho Delta le W' tau2 w1 w2)
           | TRef tau0 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | LocV l1, LocV l2 =>
                   match wmap W l1 with
                   | Some (l2', tau') => l2' = l2 /\ tau' = tau0 /\
                       (match wst1 W !! l1, wst2 W !! l2 with
                        | Some x1, Some x2 => Vty tau0 x1 x2
                        | _,_ => False end)
                   | None => False
                   end
               | _,_ => False
               end
           | TForall _ tau0 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | TLamV b1, TLamV b2 =>
                   forall (R : TyRel) (W' : World), le W W' ->
                     forall (w1 w2 : val),
                       rtc pstep (TApp (#v1), wst1 W') (#w1, wst1 W') ->
                       rtc pstep (TApp (#v2), wst2 W') (#w2, wst2 W') ->
                       V k' rho (fun x => match x with 0 => R | S n => Delta n end)
                         le W' tau0 w1 w2
               | _,_ => False
               end
           | TLForall _ tau0 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | TLLamV b1, TLLamV b2 =>
                   forall (l' : label) (W' : World), le W W' ->
                     forall (w1 w2 : val),
                       rtc pstep (TLApp (#v1), wst1 W') (#w1, wst1 W') ->
                       rtc pstep (TLApp (#v2), wst2 W') (#w2, wst2 W') ->
                       V k' (fun x => match x with 0 => l' | S n => rho n end)
                         Delta le W' tau0 w1 w2
               | _,_ => False
               end
           | TExist tau0 => fun v1 v2 =>
               match v1, v2 with
               | PackV a1, PackV a2 =>
                   exists (R : TyRel) (W' : World), le W W' /\
                     V k' rho (fun x => match x with 0 => R | S n => Delta n end)
                       le W' tau0 a1 a2
               | _,_ => False
               end
           | TRec tau0 => fun v1 v2 =>
               V k' rho Delta le W
                 (hsubst_sectype (TRec tau0 .: ids) tau0)
                 (unfold_val v1) (unfold_val v2)
           end
         end
       end) tau v1 v2
  end.

(* Related value environments for a context. *)
Fixpoint EnvRel (k : nat) (rho : var -> label) (Delta : tenv)
    (le : World -> World -> Prop) (W : World) (Gamma : list sectype)
    (d1 d2 : var -> val) {struct Gamma} : Prop :=
  match Gamma with
  | [] => True
  | tau :: Gamma' =>
      V k rho Delta le W tau (d1 0) (d2 0) /\
      EnvRel k rho Delta le W Gamma'
        (fun n => d1 (S n)) (fun n => d2 (S n))
  end.

(* The expression relation: two runs (from the world's heaps) terminate in  *)
(* values that are related at the given type in some future world.          *)
Definition E (k : nat) (rho : var -> label) (Delta : tenv)
    (le : World -> World -> Prop) (W : World) (tau : sectype)
    (e1 e2 : expr) : Prop :=
  forall (v1 v2 : val) (sigma1 sigma2 : state),
    rtc pstep (e1, wst1 W) (#v1, sigma1) ->
    rtc pstep (e2, wst2 W) (#v2, sigma2) ->
    exists W' : World,
      le W W' /\ wst1 W' = sigma1 /\ wst2 W' = sigma2 /\
      V k rho Delta le W' tau v1 v2.

Theorem soundness_tini (e : expr) v1 v2 v1' v2' ℓ ℓ' :
    ℓ' ⋢ ζ →
    ℓ  ⊑ ζ →
    [TBool @ (LLabel ℓ')] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ e : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ) →
    [] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ #v1 : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ') →
    [] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ #v2 : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ') →
    ((∃ σ1, rtc pstep (e.[# v1/], ∅) (# v1', σ1)) ∧
     (∃ σ2, rtc pstep (e.[# v2/], ∅) (# v2', σ2))) →
    v1' = v2'.

End soundness.

From Coq.ssr Require Import ssreflect.

From stdpp Require Import base prelude list gmap.

Class Lattice (A : Type) := {
    lat_equiv :> Equiv A;
    lat_equiv_equiv :> Equivalence lat_equiv;
    lat_equiv_dec :> RelDecision lat_equiv;
    join : A → A → A;
    join_proper :> Proper ((≡) ==> (≡) ==> (≡)) join;
    join_commutative :> Comm (≡) join;
    join_associative :> Assoc (≡) join;
    join_idempotent  :> IdemP (≡) join;

    bot : A;
    bot_left_id  :> LeftId (≡) bot join;
    bot_right_id :> RightId (≡) bot join;

    top : A;
    top_left_absorb :> LeftAbsorb (≡) top join;
    top_right_absorb :> RightAbsorb (≡) top join;
}.

#[global] Existing Instance lat_equiv.

Class SecurityLattice (label : Type) := {
   lattice :> Lattice label;
   ζ : label;
}.

#[global] Existing Instance lattice.

Infix "⊔" := join (at level 50) : stdpp_scope.

Notation "⊥" := bot : stdpp_scope.

Notation "⊤" := top : stdpp_scope.

Section Order.

Context `{lattice : Lattice label}.

Implicit Types a b : label.

Definition order a b := a ⊔ b ≡ b.

End Order.

Notation "a ⊑ b" := (order a b) (at level 70) : stdpp_scope.

Notation "a ⋢ b" := (¬ (order a b)) (at level 70) : stdpp_scope.

Section Lemmas.

Context `{lattice : Lattice label}.

Implicit Types ℓ : label.

End Lemmas.

From logrel_ifc.prelude Require Export base.

From stdpp Require Import gmap countable.

Module lambda_sec.

Inductive binop := Add | Sub | Mult | Eq | Le | Lt.

Record loc := { loc_car : Z }.

Global Instance loc_eq_decision : EqDecision loc := ltac:(solve_decision).

Global Instance loc_countable : Countable loc :=
  ltac:(apply (inj_countable' loc_car (λ i, {| loc_car := i |})); intros []; done).

Inductive expr :=
  | Var (x : var)
  | Lam (e : {bind expr})
  | App (e1 e2 : expr)
  | LetIn (e1 : expr) (e2 : {bind expr})
  | Seq (e1 e2 : expr)

  | Unit
  | Bool (b : bool)
  | Nat (n : nat)
  | BinOp (op : binop) (e1 e2 : expr)
  | If (e0 e1 e2 : expr)

  | Pair (e1 e2 : expr)
  | Proj1 (e : expr)
  | Proj2 (e : expr)

  | InjL (e : expr)
  | InjR (e : expr)
  | Case (e0 : expr) (e1 e2 : {bind expr})

  | Loc (l : loc)
  | Alloc (e : expr)
  | Store (e1 e2 : expr)
  | Load (e : expr)

  | TLam (e : expr)
  | TApp (e : expr)

  | TLLam (e : expr)
  | TLApp (e : expr)

  | Pack (e : expr)
  | Unpack (e1 : expr) (e2 : {bind expr})

  | Fold (e : expr)
  | Unfold (e : expr)
  .

Instance Ids_expr : Ids expr := ltac:(derive).
Instance Rename_expr : Rename expr := ltac:(derive).
Instance Subst_expr : Subst expr := ltac:(derive).

Inductive val :=
  | UnitV
  | BoolV (b : bool)
  | NatV (n : nat)
  | LamV (e : expr)
  | TLamV (e : expr)
  | TLLamV (e : expr)
  | PairV (l r: val)
  | InjLV (v: val)
  | InjRV (v: val)
  | LocV (l : loc)
  | FoldV (v : val)
  | PackV (v : val).

Fixpoint of_val (v : val) : expr :=
    match v with
    | UnitV => Unit
    | BoolV b => Bool b
    | NatV n => Nat n
    | LamV e => Lam e
    | TLamV e => TLam e
    | TLLamV e => TLLam e
    | PairV v1 v2 => Pair (of_val v1) (of_val v2)
    | InjLV v => InjL (of_val v)
    | InjRV v => InjR (of_val v)
    | LocV l => Loc l
    | FoldV v => Fold (of_val v)
    | PackV v => Pack (of_val v)
    end.

Notation "# v" := (of_val v) (at level 20).

Definition binop_eval (op : binop) (a b : nat) : val :=
    match op with
    | Add => NatV (a + b)
    | Sub => NatV (a - b)
    | Mult => NatV (a * b)
    | Eq => BoolV $ bool_decide (a = b)
    | Le => BoolV $ bool_decide (a ≤ b)
    | Lt => BoolV $ bool_decide (a < b)
    end.

Fixpoint to_val (e : expr) : option val :=
    match e with
    | Unit => Some UnitV
    | Bool b => Some $ BoolV b
    | Nat n => Some $ NatV n
    | Lam e => Some $ LamV e
    | TLam e => Some $ TLamV e
    | TLLam e => Some $ TLLamV e
    | Pair e1 e2 => v1 ← to_val e1; v2 ← to_val e2; Some $ PairV v1 v2
    | InjL e => InjLV <$> to_val e
    | InjR e => InjRV <$> to_val e
    | Loc l => Some $ LocV l
    | Fold e => v ← to_val e; Some (FoldV v)
    | Pack e => v ← to_val e; Some (PackV v)
    | _ => None
    end.

Inductive ectx_item :=
  | AppLCtx (e2 : expr)
  | AppRCtx (v1 : val)

OK so we must build the logical relation and fundamental lemma. Given the complexity, let me think about the most economical formalization that suffices for the theorem.

Key observations to simplify:
- The theorem only needs values of base type TBool at label ℓ, and inputs at TBool @ LLabel ℓ' (high) with empty env.
- We need the fundamental lemma for all types because e can contain arbitrary typed sub-expressions (functions, refs, recursive types, polymorphism...). So yes, full model.

But we can perhaps use a **syntactic logical relation in terms of a "relational interpretation" that is not step-indexed**, because the language's pstep relation may be nondeterministic but deterministic per allocation choice. Let me examine pstep and head_step precisely.

      head_step (App (Lam e1) e2) σ [] e1.[e2/] σ []

      head_step (Alloc e) σ [] (Loc l) (<[l := v]>σ) []

      to_val e = Some v →
      is_Some $ σ !! l →
      head_step (Store (Loc l) e) σ [] Unit (<[l := v]>σ) []
  | LoadS l v σ :
      σ !! l = Some v →
      head_step (Load $ Loc l) σ [] (of_val v) σ []

      to_val e1 = Some v1 →
      head_step (Unpack (Pack e1) e2) σ [] (e2.[e1/]) σ []

| Ectx_step K e1' e2' :
    e1 = fill K e1' → e2 = fill K e2' →
    head_step e1' σ1 κ e2' σ2 efs →
    prim_step e1 σ1 κ e2 σ2 efs.

From stdpp Require Import relations.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang typing.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.

Section soundness.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Theorem soundness_tini (e : expr) v1 v2 v1' v2' ℓ ℓ' :
    ℓ' ⋢ ζ →
    ℓ  ⊑ ζ →
    [TBool @ (LLabel ℓ')] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ e : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ) →
    [] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ #v1 : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ') →
    [] # (LLabel ℓ) ⊢ₜ #v2 : TBool @ (LLabel ℓ') →
    ((∃ σ1, rtc pstep (e.[# v1/], ∅) (# v1', σ1)) ∧
     (∃ σ2, rtc pstep (e.[# v2/], ∅) (# v2', σ2))) →
    v1' = v2'.

End soundness.

  match l with
  | LVar x => rho x
  | LJoin a b => interp_label rho a ⊔ interp_label rho b

Lemma interp_label_subst (rho : var -> label) (sigma : var -> label_term)
    (l : label_term) :
  interp_label rho l.[sigma] = interp_label (fun x => interp_label rho (sigma x)) l.
Proof. induction l; simpl; f_equal; assumption. Qed.

Lemma interp_label_ren (rho : var -> label) (xi : var -> var) (l : label_term) :
  interp_label rho l.[ren xi] = interp_label (fun x => rho (xi x)) l.

Lemma flowsto_sound (rho : var -> label) (l1 l2 : label_term) :
  l1 ⊑ₛ l2 -> interp_label rho l1 ⊑ interp_label rho l2.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl.
  - apply order_refl.
  - eapply order_trans; eauto.
  - apply order_bot.
  - apply order_top.
  - assumption.
  - apply order_join_lub; assumption.
Qed.

From stdpp Require Import relations.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang typing.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith.Wf_nat Lia Wellfounded.
From Equations Require Import Equations.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Section model.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Fixpoint interp_label (rho : var -> label) (l : label_term) : label :=
  match l with
  | LVar x => rho x
  | LJoin a b => interp_label rho a ⊔ interp_label rho b
  | LLabel x => x
  end.

Definition obs_dec (l : label) : {l ⊑ ζ} + {~ (l ⊑ ζ)} :=
  match @lat_equiv_dec label lattice (l ⊔ ζ) ζ with
  | left H => left H
  | right H => right H
  end.

Definition World := (state * state * (loc -> option (loc * sectype)))%type.
Definition wst1 (W : World) : state := W.1.1.
Definition wst2 (W : World) : state := W.1.2.
Definition wmap (W : World) : loc -> option (loc * sectype) := W.2.

Inductive steps : nat -> (expr * state) -> (expr * state) -> Prop :=
| steps_0 : forall x, steps 0 x x
| steps_S : forall n x y z, pstep x y -> steps n y z -> steps (S n) x z.

Definition unfold_val (v : val) : val :=
  match v with FoldV v' => v' | v => v end.

Record TyRel := {
  tyrel : nat -> label -> World -> val -> val -> Prop;
  tyrel_mono : forall k' k, k' <= k ->
    forall l W v1 v2, tyrel k l W v1 v2 -> tyrel k' l W v1 v2
}.
Definition tenv := var -> TyRel.

Definition extend_tenv (R : TyRel) (Delta : tenv) : tenv :=
  fun x => match x with 0 => R | S n => Delta n end.
Definition extend_rho (l : label) (rho : var -> label) : var -> label :=
  fun x => match x with 0 => l | S n => rho n end.

Inductive vcall :=
| Vc (k : nat) (rho : var -> label) (Delta : tenv) (W : World)
     (tau : sectype) (v1 v2 : val)
| Ec (k : nat) (rho : var -> label) (Delta : tenv) (W : World)
     (tau : sectype) (e1 e2 : expr).

Definition vmeasure (c : vcall) : nat :=
  match c with Vc k _ _ _ _ _ _ => 2*k + 1 | Ec k _ _ _ _ _ _ => 2*k end.
#[local] Instance wf_vmeasure : WellFounded (fun x y : vcall => vmeasure x < vmeasure y).
Proof. apply wf_inverse_image with (f:=vmeasure). apply lt_wf. Qed.

Equations VE (c : vcall) : Prop by wf c (fun x y => vmeasure x < vmeasure y) :=
  VE (Vc 0 rho Delta W tau v1 v2) => True;

  VE (Vc (S k') rho Delta W (TSec l TUnit) v1 v2) =>
    match obs_dec (interp_label rho l) with left _ => True | right _ => True end;
  VE (Vc (S k') rho Delta W (TSec l TBool) v1 v2) =>
    match obs_dec (interp_label rho l) with left _ => v1 = v2 | right _ => True end;
  VE (Vc (S k') rho Delta W (TSec l TNat) v1 v2) =>
    match obs_dec (interp_label rho l) with left _ => v1 = v2 | right _ => True end;
  VE (Vc (S k') rho Delta W (TSec l (TVar x)) v1 v2) =>
    match obs_dec (interp_label rho l) with
    | left _ => (Delta x).(tyrel) (S k') (interp_label rho l) W v1 v2
    | right _ => True
    end;
  VE (Vc (S k') rho Delta W (TSec l (TProd tau1 tau2)) (PairV a1 b1) (PairV a2 b2)) =>
    match obs_dec (interp_label rho l) with
    | left _ => VE (Vc k' rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2) /\ VE (Vc k' rho Delta W tau2 b1 b2)

From stdpp Require Import relations.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang typing.
From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Import lattice.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith.Wf_nat Lia.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Section model.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Fixpoint interp_label (rho : var -> label) (l : label_term) : label :=
  match l with
  | LVar x => rho x
  | LJoin a b => interp_label rho a ⊔ interp_label rho b
  | LLabel x => x
  end.

Definition obs_dec (l : label) : {l ⊑ ζ} + {~ (l ⊑ ζ)} :=
  match @lat_equiv_dec label lattice (l ⊔ ζ) ζ with
  | left H => left H
  | right H => right H
  end.

Definition World := (state * state * (loc -> option (loc * sectype)))%type.
Definition wst1 (W : World) : state := W.1.1.
Definition wst2 (W : World) : state := W.1.2.
Definition wmap (W : World) : loc -> option (loc * sectype) := W.2.

Inductive steps : nat -> (expr * state) -> (expr * state) -> Prop :=
| steps_0 : forall x, steps 0 x x
| steps_S : forall n x y z, pstep x y -> steps n y z -> steps (S n) x z.

Definition unfold_val (v : val) : val :=
  match v with FoldV v' => v' | v => v end.

Record TyRel := {
  tyrel : nat -> label -> World -> val -> val -> Prop;
  tyrel_mono : forall k' k, k' <= k ->
    forall l W v1 v2, tyrel k l W v1 v2 -> tyrel k' l W v1 v2
}.
Definition tenv := var -> TyRel.

Definition extend_tenv (R : TyRel) (Delta : tenv) : tenv :=
  fun x => match x with 0 => R | S n => Delta n end.
Definition extend_rho (l : label) (rho : var -> label) : var -> label :=
  fun x => match x with 0 => l | S n => rho n end.

Definition VF := (var -> label) -> tenv -> World -> sectype -> val -> val -> Prop.
Definition EF := (var -> label) -> tenv -> World -> sectype -> expr -> expr -> Prop.

Definition Vstep (K : nat) (Vlow : nat -> VF) (Elow : nat -> EF) : VF :=
  fun rho Delta W tau v1 v2 =>
  match K with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    match tau with
    | TSec l t =>
      match obs_dec (interp_label rho l) with
      | right _ => True
      | left _ =>
        match t with
        | TUnit => True
        | TBool => v1 = v2
        | TNat => v1 = v2
        | TVar x => (Delta x).(tyrel) (S k') (interp_label rho l) W v1 v2
        | TProd tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | PairV a1 b1, PairV a2 b2 =>
                Vlow k' rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2 /\
                Vlow k' rho Delta W tau2 b1 b2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TSum tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | InjLV a1, InjLV a2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2
            | InjRV a1, InjRV a2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau2 a1 a2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TArrow _ tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | LamV b1, LamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' ->
                  forall a1 a2,
                    Elow j rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2 ->
                    Elow j rho Delta W tau2 (App (Lam b1) a1) (App (Lam b2) a2)
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TRef tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | LocV l1, LocV l2 =>
                match wmap W l1 with
                | Some (l2', tau') =>
                    (l2' = l2) /\ (tau' = tau0) /\
                    match wst1 W !! l1, wst2 W !! l2 with
                    | Some x1, Some x2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau0 x1 x2
                    | _,_ => False
                    end
                | None => False
                end
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TForall _ tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | TLamV b1, TLamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' -> forall (R : TyRel),
                  Elow j rho (extend_tenv R Delta) W tau0
                    (TApp (TLam b1)) (TApp (TLam b2))
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TLForall _ tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | TLLamV b1, TLLamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' -> forall (l' : label),
                  Elow j (extend_rho l' rho) Delta W tau0
                    (TLApp (TLLam b1)) (TLApp (TLLam b2))
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TExist tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | PackV a1, PackV a2 =>
                exists (R : TyRel),
                  Vlow k' rho (extend_tenv R Delta) W tau0 a1 a2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TRec tau0 =>
            Vlow k' rho Delta W
              (hsubst_sectype (TRec tau0 .: ids) tau0)
              (unfold_val v1) (unfold_val v2)
        end
      end
    end
  end.

Definition Estep (K : nat) (Vlow : nat -> VF) : EF :=
  fun rho Delta W tau e1 e2 =>
  match K with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    forall (n1 n2 : nat) (v1 v2 : val) (s1 s2 : state),
      steps n1 (e1, wst1 W) (#v1, s1) ->
      steps n2 (e2, wst2 W) (#v2, s2) ->
      n1 + n2 <= S k' ->
      exists (wm' : loc -> option (loc * sectype)),
        (forall l l' tau0, wmap W l = Some (l', tau0) -> wm' l = Some (l', tau0)) /\
        Vlow (S k' - n1 - n2 - 1) rho Delta (s1, s2, wm') tau v1 v2
  end.

Record LVL := { lvlV : VF; lvlE : EF }.

Definition base_lvl : LVL :=
  {| lvlV := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => True; lvlE := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => True |}.

Fixpoint fam (K : nat) : nat -> LVL :=
  match K with
  | 0 => fun _ => base_lvl
  | S k' =>
      let old := fam k' in
      let Vlow j := (old j).(lvlV) in
      let Elow j := (old j).(lvlE) in
      let newlvl :=
          {| lvlV := Vstep (S k') Vlow Elow;
             lvlE := Estep (S k') Vlow |} in
      fun j => if Nat.eqb j (S k') then newlvl else old j
  end.

Definition V (k : nat) : VF := (fam k k).(lvlV).
Definition E (k : nat) : EF := (fam k k).(lvlE).

Lemma fam_agree : forall K j, j <= K -> fam K j = fam j j.
Proof.
  induction K as [|K IH]; intros j Hj.
  - assert (j = 0) by lia. subst j. cbn. reflexivity.
  - destruct j as [|j].
    + cbn [fam]. rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. reflexivity.
    + cbn [fam].
      destruct (Nat.eqb (S j) (S K)) eqn:E.
      * apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. subst j. reflexivity.
      * apply Nat.eqb_neq in E.
        assert (j <= K) by lia.
        rewrite (IH j H0). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Equation for V at a successor fuel, in terms of the lower V/E. *)
Lemma V_S_eq : forall k' rho Delta W tau v1 v2,
  V (S k') rho Delta W tau v1 v2 =
  Vstep (S k') (fun j => V j) (fun j => E j) rho Delta W tau v1 v2.
Proof.
  intros. unfold V.
  cbn [fam].
  rewrite Nat.eqb_refl.
  cbn.
  (* Need to replace the accessors (fam k' j) by V j. *)
Abort.

End model.
EOF

Definition EF := (var -> label) -> tenv -> World -> sectype -> expr -> expr -> Prop.

Definition Vstep (K : nat) (Vlow : nat -> VF) (Elow : nat -> EF) : VF :=
  fun rho Delta W tau v1 v2 =>
  match K with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    match tau with
    | TSec l t =>
      match @lat_equiv_dec label lattice (interp_label rho l ⊔ ζ) ζ with
      | right _ => True
      | left _ =>
        match t with
        | TUnit => True
        | TBool => v1 = v2
        | TNat => v1 = v2
        | TVar x => (Delta x).(tyrel) (S k') (interp_label rho l) W v1 v2
        | TProd tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | PairV a1 b1, PairV a2 b2 =>
                Vlow k' rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2 /\
                Vlow k' rho Delta W tau2 b1 b2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TSum tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | InjLV a1, InjLV a2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2
            | InjRV a1, InjRV a2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau2 a1 a2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TArrow _ tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | LamV b1, LamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' ->
                  forall a1 a2,
                    Elow j rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2 ->
                    Elow j rho Delta W tau2 (App (Lam b1) a1) (App (Lam b2) a2)
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TRef tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | LocV l1, LocV l2 =>
                match wmap W l1 with
                | Some (l2', tau') =>
                    (l2' = l2) /\ (tau' = tau0) /\
                    match wst1 W !! l1, wst2 W !! l2 with
                    | Some x1, Some x2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau0 x1 x2
                    | _,_ => False
                    end
                | None => False
                end
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TForall _ tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | TLamV b1, TLamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' -> forall (R : TyRel),
                  Elow j rho (extend_tenv R Delta) W tau0
                    (TApp (TLam b1)) (TApp (TLam b2))
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TLForall _ tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | TLLamV b1, TLLamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' -> forall (l' : label),
                  Elow j (extend_rho l' rho) Delta W tau0
                    (TLApp (TLLam b1)) (TLApp (TLLam b2))
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TExist tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | PackV a1, PackV a2 =>
                exists (R : TyRel),
                  Vlow k' rho (extend_tenv R Delta) W tau0 a1 a2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TRec tau0 =>
            Vlow k' rho Delta W
              (hsubst_sectype (TRec tau0 .: ids) tau0)
              (unfold_val v1) (unfold_val v2)
        end
      end
    end
  end.

Definition Estep (K : nat) (Vlow : nat -> VF) : EF :=
  fun rho Delta W tau e1 e2 =>
  match K with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    forall (n1 n2 : nat) (v1 v2 : val) (s1 s2 : state),
      steps n1 (e1, wst1 W) (#v1, s1) ->
      steps n2 (e2, wst2 W) (#v2, s2) ->

Lemma fill_item_to_val (Ki : ectx_item) (e : expr) (w : val) :

  - simpl in Hs. apply IH in Hs. destruct Hs as [w Hw].

      V (S k') rho Delta W tau v1 v2 -> V k' rho Delta W tau v1 v2)
    rho Delta W l tau0 (v1 v2 : val),
  V (S (S k')) rho Delta W (TExist tau0 @ l) v1 v2 ->
  V (S k') rho Delta W (TExist tau0 @ l) v1 v2.

  intros k' IH rho Delta W l tau0 v1 v2 Hs.
  destruct v1; destruct v2;
  try (rewrite V_exist_eq in Hs |- *; eapply obs_case_imp; [|exact Hs];

  try (unfold V in Hs |- *; cbn [fam] in Hs |- *;
       rewrite Nat.eqb_refl in Hs |- *; cbn [Vstep] in Hs |- *; exact Hs).

Proof.

  rewrite V_rec_eq in Hs |- *.

Definition closed_expr (e : expr) : Prop := forall sigma, e.[sigma] = e.

Lemma up_ext (s t : var -> expr) :
  (forall x, s x = t x) -> forall x, up s x = up t x.
Proof.
  intros Hs x. unfold up. destruct x; simpl; auto.
  rewrite Hs. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ext (e : expr) : forall (s t : var -> expr),
  (forall x, s x = t x) -> e.[s] = e.[t].
Proof.
  induction e; intros s t Hs; simpl; try reflexivity;
  try (erewrite IHe; eauto using up_ext);
  try (erewrite IHe1; eauto using up_ext);
  try (erewrite IHe2; eauto using up_ext);
  try (erewrite IHe3; eauto using up_ext);
  try (f_equal; eauto using up_ext);
  try (apply Hs).
Qed.

Lemma up_subst_beta (b : expr) (sigma : var -> expr) (w : expr) :
  (forall x, closed_expr (sigma x)) ->
  (b.[up sigma]).[w .: ids] = b.[w .: sigma].

  rewrite (expr_subst_comp b (up sigma) (w .: ids)).

    rewrite (Hs n (ren (+1))).
    rewrite (Hs n (w .: ids)).
    reflexivity.
Qed.

I continued and added the lambda-beta substitution layer, which was the immediate obstacle for the `Lam`/`App` case.

## Newly proved and compiling

- `closed_expr` — an expression is closed under all substitutions.
- `up_ext` — pointwise equality of substitutions is preserved by `up`.
- `subst_ext` — substitution is extensional: pointwise-equal substitutions give equal substituted expressions. Proved by structural induction on expressions, including all binders, without adding axioms.
- `up_subst_beta` — the lambda-beta substitution identity:
  ```
  (b.[up sigma]).[w .: ids] = b.[w .: sigma]
  ```
  whenever all values of `sigma` are closed. This is proved using `expr_subst_comp`, `subst_ext`, and Autosubst’s `rename_subst`.

Retained from this session: the frame-aware expression relation (`Frame`, `FrameV`, revised `E_S_eq`/`E_mono`/`E_from_Vsub`/`E_value`), the `App` fill inversion (`app_fill_inv`), one-step `App` decomposition (`pstep_app_inv`, `pstep_app_lam_inv`), full beta-run decomposition (`steps_app_lam_value_inv`), `V_mono`, `E_mono`, `V_label_mono`, `V_secsubtype`, `fundamental_sub`, `fundamental_var`, and the base typing-rule cases.

## Build status

`make` still stops only at the open target:

```

Error: Command not supported (Open proofs remain)
```

No forbidden proof escapes are present; support files and `_CoqProject` are unchanged.

## Remaining bottleneck

The beta identity requires **closed environment values**. The next necessary layer is a closedness invariant:

1. A notion of closed values/expressions and closed heaps.
2. `EnvRel` carrying closedness of its values.
3. Closedness of the theorem’s initial values `v1`, `v2` (they are typed at `TBool @ high`, hence booleans; this can be obtained by a syntactic `typed_bool_value` inversion).
4. Closedness preservation along runs, or an equivalent invariant on the logical relation’s worlds/heaps.

Definition Vstep (K : nat) (Vlow : nat -> VF) (Elow : nat -> EF) : VF :=
  fun rho Delta W tau v1 v2 =>
  match K with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    match tau with
    | TSec l t =>
      obs_case (interp_label rho l) (match t with
        | TUnit => True
        | TBool => v1 = v2
        | TNat => v1 = v2
        | TVar x => (Delta x).(tyrel) (S k') (interp_label rho l) W v1 v2
        | TProd tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | PairV a1 b1, PairV a2 b2 =>
                Vlow k' rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2 /\
                Vlow k' rho Delta W tau2 b1 b2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TSum tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | InjLV a1, InjLV a2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2
            | InjRV a1, InjRV a2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau2 a1 a2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TArrow _ tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | LamV b1, LamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' ->
                  forall a1 a2,
                    Elow j rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2 ->
                    Elow j rho Delta W tau2 (App (Lam b1) a1) (App (Lam b2) a2)
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TRef tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | LocV l1, LocV l2 =>
                match wmap W l1 with
                | Some (l2', tau') =>
                    (l2' = l2) /\ (tau' = tau0) /\
                    match wst1 W !! l1, wst2 W !! l2 with
                    | Some x1, Some x2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau0 x1 x2
                    | _,_ => False
                    end
                | None => False
                end
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TForall _ tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | TLamV b1, TLamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' -> forall (R : TyRel),
                  Elow j rho (extend_tenv R Delta) W tau0
                    (TApp (TLam b1)) (TApp (TLam b2))
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TLForall _ tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | TLLamV b1, TLLamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' -> forall (l' : label),
                  Elow j (extend_rho l' rho) Delta W tau0
                    (TLApp (TLLam b1)) (TLApp (TLLam b2))
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TExist tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | PackV a1, PackV a2 =>
                exists (R : TyRel),
                  Vlow k' rho (extend_tenv R Delta) W tau0 a1 a2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TRec tau0 =>
            Vlow k' rho Delta W
              (hsubst_sectype (TRec tau0 .: ids) tau0)
              (unfold_val v1) (unfold_val v2)
        end)
    end
  end.

Definition Frame (Vlow : nat -> VF) (r : nat) (W W' : World) : Prop :=
  forall j, j <= r -> forall rho Delta tau v1 v2,
    Vlow j rho Delta W tau v1 v2 -> Vlow j rho Delta W' tau v1 v2.

Definition Estep (K : nat) (Vlow : nat -> VF) : EF :=
  fun rho Delta W tau e1 e2 =>
  match K with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    forall (n1 n2 : nat) (v1 v2 : val) (s1 s2 : state),
      steps n1 (e1, wst1 W) (#v1, s1) ->
      steps n2 (e2, wst2 W) (#v2, s2) ->
      n1 + n2 <= S k' ->
      exists (wm' : loc -> option (loc * sectype)),
        (forall l l' tau0, wmap W l = Some (l', tau0) -> wm' l = Some (l', tau0)) /\
        Vlow (S k' - n1 - n2 - 1) rho Delta (s1, s2, wm') tau v1 v2 /\
        Frame Vlow (S k' - n1 - n2 - 1) W (s1, s2, wm')
  end.

Record LVL := { lvlV : VF; lvlE : EF }.

Definition base_lvl : LVL :=
  {| lvlV := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => True; lvlE := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => True |}.

Fixpoint fam (K : nat) : nat -> LVL :=
  match K with
  | 0 => fun _ => base_lvl
  | S k' =>
      let old := fam k' in
      let Vlow j := (old j).(lvlV) in
      let Elow j := (old j).(lvlE) in
      let newlvl :=
          {| lvlV := Vstep (S k') Vlow Elow;
             lvlE := Estep (S k') Vlow |} in
      fun j => if Nat.eqb j (S k') then newlvl else old j
  end.

Definition V (k : nat) : VF := (fam k k).(lvlV).
Definition E (k : nat) : EF := (fam k k).(lvlE).

Definition FrameV (r : nat) (W W' : World) : Prop :=
  forall j, j <= r -> forall rho Delta tau v1 v2,
    V j rho Delta W tau v1 v2 -> V j rho Delta W' tau v1 v2.

                Vlow k' rho Delta W tau2 b1 b2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TSum tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | InjLV a1, InjLV a2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2
            | InjRV a1, InjRV a2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau2 a1 a2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TArrow _ tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | LamV b1, LamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' ->
                  forall a1 a2,
                    Elow j rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2 ->
                    Elow j rho Delta W tau2 (App (Lam b1) a1) (App (Lam b2) a2)
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TRef tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | LocV l1, LocV l2 =>
                match wmap W l1 with
                | Some (l2', tau') =>
                    (l2' = l2) /\ (tau' = tau0) /\
                    match wst1 W !! l1, wst2 W !! l2 with
                    | Some x1, Some x2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau0 x1 x2
                    | _,_ => False
                    end
                | None => False
                end
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TForall _ tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | TLamV b1, TLamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' -> forall (R : TyRel),
                  Elow j rho (extend_tenv R Delta) W tau0
                    (TApp (TLam b1)) (TApp (TLam b2))
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TLForall _ tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | TLLamV b1, TLLamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' -> forall (l' : label),
                  Elow j (extend_rho l' rho) Delta W tau0
                    (TLApp (TLLam b1)) (TLApp (TLLam b2))
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TExist tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | PackV a1, PackV a2 =>
                exists (R : TyRel),
                  Vlow k' rho (extend_tenv R Delta) W tau0 a1 a2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TRec tau0 =>
            Vlow k' rho Delta W
              (hsubst_sectype (TRec tau0 .: ids) tau0)
              (unfold_val v1) (unfold_val v2)
        end)
    end
  end.

Definition Frame (Vlow : nat -> VF) (r : nat) (W W' : World) : Prop :=
  forall j, j <= r -> forall rho Delta tau v1 v2,
    Vlow j rho Delta W tau v1 v2 -> Vlow j rho Delta W' tau v1 v2.

Definition Estep (K : nat) (Vlow : nat -> VF) : EF :=
  fun rho Delta W tau e1 e2 =>
  match K with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    forall (n1 n2 : nat) (v1 v2 : val) (s1 s2 : state),
      steps n1 (e1, wst1 W) (#v1, s1) ->
      steps n2 (e2, wst2 W) (#v2, s2) ->
      n1 + n2 <= S k' ->
      exists (wm' : loc -> option (loc * sectype)),
        (forall l l' tau0, wmap W l = Some (l', tau0) -> wm' l = Some (l', tau0)) /\
        Vlow (S k' - n1 - n2 - 1) rho Delta (s1, s2, wm') tau v1 v2 /\
        Frame Vlow (S k' - n1 - n2 - 1) W (s1, s2, wm')
  end.

Record LVL := { lvlV : VF; lvlE : EF }.

Definition base_lvl : LVL :=
  {| lvlV := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => True; lvlE := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => True |}.

Fixpoint fam (K : nat) : nat -> LVL :=
  match K with
  | 0 => fun _ => base_lvl
  | S k' =>
      let old := fam k' in
      let Vlow j := (old j).(lvlV) in
      let Elow j := (old j).(lvlE) in
      let newlvl :=
          {| lvlV := Vstep (S k') Vlow Elow;
             lvlE := Estep (S k') Vlow |} in
      fun j => if Nat.eqb j (S k') then newlvl else old j
  end.

Definition V (k : nat) : VF := (fam k k).(lvlV).
Definition E (k : nat) : EF := (fam k k).(lvlE).

Definition FrameV (r : nat) (W W' : World) : Prop :=
  forall j, j <= r -> forall rho Delta tau v1 v2,
    V j rho Delta W tau v1 v2 -> V j rho Delta W' tau v1 v2.

Lemma V_bool_eq : forall k' rho Delta W l (v1 v2 : val),
  V (S k') rho Delta W (TBool @ l) v1 v2 <->
  obs_case (interp_label rho l) (v1 = v2).
Proof.
  intros. unfold V. cbn [fam]. rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. cbn [Vstep].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma V_arrow_eq : forall k' rho Delta W l le tau1 tau2 (b1 b2 : expr),
  V (S k') rho Delta W (TArrow le tau1 tau2 @ l) (LamV b1) (LamV b2) <->
  obs_case (interp_label rho l)
    (forall j, j < S k' -> forall a1 a2,
        E j rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2 ->
        E j rho Delta W tau2 (App (Lam b1) a1) (App (Lam b2) a2)).
Proof.
  intros. unfold V. cbn [fam]. rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. cbn [Vstep].
  apply obs_case_iff. split; intros Hrel j Hj a1 a2 Harg.
  - assert (Hle : j <= k') by lia.
    specialize (Hrel j Hj a1 a2). rewrite <- (@Elow_fam k' j Hle) in Harg.
    apply Hrel in Harg. rewrite (@Elow_fam k' j Hle) in Harg. exact Harg.
  - assert (Hle : j <= k') by lia.
    specialize (Hrel j Hj a1 a2). rewrite (@Elow_fam k' j Hle) in Harg.
    apply Hrel in Harg. rewrite (@Elow_fam k' j Hle). exact Harg.
Qed.

Lemma E_S_eq : forall k' rho Delta W tau e1 e2,

Proof.
  intros l. unfold obs_bool.

Lemma obs_case_true : forall l (P : Prop), l ⊑ ζ -> (obs_case l P <-> P).
Proof.
  intros l P Hobs. unfold obs_case.
  rewrite (proj2 (obs_bool_true l) Hobs). tauto.
Qed.

Lemma obs_case_false : forall l (P : Prop), ~ (l ⊑ ζ) -> (obs_case l P <-> True).
Proof.
  intros l P Hobs. unfold obs_case.
  assert (obs_bool l = false) as Hb.
  { destruct (obs_bool l) eqn:E; auto. exfalso. apply Hobs. apply (proj1 (obs_bool_true l)). exact E. }

Lemma fill_item_to_val (Ki : ectx_item) (e : expr) (w : val) :
  to_val (fill_item Ki e) = Some w -> exists v, to_val e = Some v.
Proof.
  destruct (to_val e) as [v|] eqn:E.
  - exists v; reflexivity.
  - destruct Ki; simpl; intro Hs;
    try (rewrite E in Hs);
    try (rewrite to_val_of_val in Hs);
    simpl in Hs; try discriminate Hs.
Qed.

Lemma fill_value_inv (K : list ectx_item) (e : expr) (v : val) :
  #v = fill K e -> exists w, to_val e = Some w.
Proof.
  revert e v. induction K as [|Ki K IH]; intros e v Hs.
  - simpl in Hs. exists v. rewrite <- Hs. apply to_val_of_val.
  - simpl in Hs. apply IH in Hs. destruct Hs as [w Hw].
    eapply fill_item_to_val; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma head_step_not_value (e : expr) (v : val) (σ : state)

Lemma pstep_value (v : val) (σ : state) (e' : expr) (σ' : state) :
  ~ pstep (#v, σ) (e', σ').
Proof.
  intros Hp. inversion Hp as [K e1' e2' Hfill _ Hhead]; subst.
  simpl in Hfill.
  destruct (fill_value_inv K e1' v Hfill) as [w Hw].
  exact (@head_step_not_value e1' w σ e2' σ' [] Hw Hhead).
Qed.

Lemma steps_value_inv (n : nat) (v : val) (σ : state) (e' : expr) (σ' : state) :

Proof.
  intros Hs. remember (#v, σ) as x eqn:Ex. remember (e', σ') as y eqn:Ey.
  revert v σ e' σ' Ex Ey.
  induction Hs as [x0 | n0 x0 y0 z Hstep Htail IH]; intros v σ e' σ' Ex Ey.
  - inversion Ex; subst. inversion Ey; subst. auto.
  - inversion Ex; subst. destruct y0 as [ey σy]. exfalso.
    eapply pstep_value; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma steps_0_inv : forall (x y : expr * state), steps 0 x y -> x = y.

Lemma E_value : forall k' rho Delta W tau (v1 v2 : val),

  destruct (steps_value_inv n1 v1 s1 (#w1) t1 Hs1) as [Hn1 [He1 Hs1']].
  destruct (steps_value_inv n2 v2 s2 (#w2) t2 Hs2) as [Hn2 [He2 Hs2']].

  - intros l l' tau0 Hm. exact Hm.
  - split.
    + subst t1 t2. apply of_val_inj in He1. apply of_val_inj in He2. subst w1 w2.
      replace (S k' - 0 - 0 - 1) with k' by lia. exact HV.
    + subst t1 t2. replace (S k' - 0 - 0 - 1) with k' by lia. apply FrameV_refl.

      steps n1 (e1, wst1 W) (#v1, s1) ->

Proof.
  intros l. unfold obs_bool.
  destruct (@lat_equiv_dec label lattice (l ⊔ ζ) ζ) as [Hord|Hord].
  - simpl. split; intros _; [exact Hord | reflexivity].
  - simpl. split; intros HH; [discriminate HH | contradiction].

  { destruct (obs_bool l) eqn:E; auto. exfalso. apply Hobs. apply (proj1 (obs_bool_true l)). exact E. }

Lemma fill_item_to_val (Ki : ectx_item) (e : expr) (w : val) :
  to_val (fill_item Ki e) = Some w -> exists v, to_val e = Some v.
Proof.
  destruct (to_val e) as [v|] eqn:E.
  - exists v; reflexivity.
  - destruct Ki; simpl; intro Hs;
    try (rewrite E in Hs);
    try (rewrite to_val_of_val in Hs);
    simpl in Hs; try discriminate Hs.
Qed.

Lemma fill_value_inv (K : list ectx_item) (e : expr) (v : val) :
  #v = fill K e -> exists w, to_val e = Some w.
Proof.
  revert e v. induction K as [|Ki K IH]; intros e v Hs.
  - simpl in Hs. exists v. rewrite <- Hs. apply to_val_of_val.
  - simpl in Hs. apply IH in Hs. destruct Hs as [w Hw].
    eapply fill_item_to_val; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma head_step_not_value (e : expr) (v : val) (σ : state)

Proof.
  intros Hv Hstep. destruct Hstep; cbn in Hv; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma pstep_value (v : val) (σ : state) (e' : expr) (σ' : state) :
  ~ pstep (#v, σ) (e', σ').
Proof.
  intros Hp. inversion Hp as [K e1' e2' Hfill _ Hhead]; subst.
  simpl in Hfill.
  destruct (fill_value_inv K e1' v Hfill) as [w Hw].
  exact (@head_step_not_value e1' w σ e2' σ' [] Hw Hhead).
Qed.

Lemma steps_value_inv (n : nat) (v : val) (σ : state) (e' : expr) (σ' : state) :
  steps n (#v, σ) (e', σ') -> n = 0 /\ e' = #v /\ σ' = σ.
Proof.
  intros Hs. remember (#v, σ) as x eqn:Ex. remember (e', σ') as y eqn:Ey.
  revert v σ e' σ' Ex Ey.
  induction Hs as [x0 | n0 x0 y0 z Hstep Htail IH]; intros v σ e' σ' Ex Ey.
  - inversion Ex; subst. inversion Ey; subst. auto.
  - inversion Ex; subst. destruct y0 as [ey σy]. exfalso.
    eapply pstep_value; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma steps_0_inv : forall (x y : expr * state), steps 0 x y -> x = y.
Proof. intros x y Hs. inversion Hs. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma E_zero : forall rho Delta W tau (e1 e2 : expr), E 0 rho Delta W tau e1 e2.
Proof. intros. unfold E. cbn [fam]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma E_value : forall k' rho Delta W tau (v1 v2 : val),
  V k' rho Delta W tau v1 v2 ->
  E (S k') rho Delta W tau (#v1) (#v2).
Proof.
  intros k' rho Delta W tau v1 v2 HV.
  destruct W as [[s1 s2] wm]. simpl in *.
  apply E_S_eq. intros n1 n2 w1 w2 t1 t2 Hs1 Hs2 Hle.
  destruct (steps_value_inv n1 v1 s1 (#w1) t1 Hs1) as [Hn1 [He1 Hs1']].
  destruct (steps_value_inv n2 v2 s2 (#w2) t2 Hs2) as [Hn2 [He2 Hs2']].
  subst n1 n2. exists wm. split.
  - intros l l' tau0 Hm. exact Hm.
  - split.
    + subst t1 t2. apply of_val_inj in He1. apply of_val_inj in He2. subst w1 w2.
      replace (S k' - 0 - 0 - 1) with k' by lia. exact HV.
    + subst t1 t2. replace (S k' - 0 - 0 - 1) with k' by lia. apply FrameV_refl.
Qed.


Lemma V_high : forall k rho Delta W (tau : sectype) (v1 v2 : val),
  ~ (interp_label rho (sectype_label tau) ⊑ ζ) ->
  V k rho Delta W tau v1 v2.
Proof.
  intros k rho Delta W tau v1 v2 Hh.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - apply V_zero.
  - destruct tau as [l t]. simpl in Hh.
    unfold V. cbn [fam]. rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. cbn [Vstep].
    apply (proj2 (obs_case_false (interp_label rho l) _ Hh)). exact I.
Qed.

Fixpoint EnvRel (k : nat) (rho : var -> label) (Delta : tenv) (W : World)
    (Gamma : list sectype) (d1 d2 : var -> val) {struct Gamma} : Prop :=
  match Gamma with
  | [] => True
  | tau :: Gamma' =>
      V k rho Delta W tau (d1 0) (d2 0) /\ EnvRel k rho Delta W Gamma' (fun n => d1 (S n)) (fun n => d2 (S n))
  end.

Definition EnvRelAll (rho : var -> label) (Delta : tenv) (W : World)
    (Gamma : list sectype) (d1 d2 : var -> val) : Prop :=
  forall k, EnvRel k rho Delta W Gamma d1 d2.

Definition env_subst_vals (d : var -> val) : var -> expr := fun x => #(d x).

Lemma EnvRel_nil : forall k rho Delta W d1 d2, EnvRel k rho Delta W [] d1 d2.
Proof. intros. simpl. exact I. Qed.

Lemma EnvRel_cons : forall k rho Delta W tau Gamma d1 d2 v1 v2,
  V k rho Delta W tau v1 v2 ->
  EnvRel k rho Delta W Gamma d1 d2 ->
  EnvRel k rho Delta W (tau :: Gamma)
    (fun x => match x with 0 => v1 | S n => d1 n end)
    (fun x => match x with 0 => v2 | S n => d2 n end).
Proof.
  intros k rho0 Delta0 W0 tau0 Gamma0 d1 d2 v1 v2 HV HEn. simpl. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* Expression substitution lemmas (Autosubst).                         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Global Instance SubstLemmas_expr_inst : SubstLemmas expr := ltac:(derive).

Lemma expr_subst_comp (e : expr) (sigma tau : var -> expr) :
  e.[sigma].[tau] = e.[sigma >> tau].
Proof. apply subst_comp. Qed.

Lemma expr_subst_id (e : expr) : e.[ids] = e.
Proof. apply subst_id. Qed.

Definition closed_expr (e : expr) : Prop := forall sigma, e.[sigma] = e.

Lemma up_ext (s t : var -> expr) :
  (forall x, s x = t x) -> forall x, up s x = up t x.
Proof.
  intros Hs x. unfold up. destruct x; simpl; auto.
  rewrite Hs. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ext (e : expr) : forall (s t : var -> expr),
  (forall x, s x = t x) -> e.[s] = e.[t].
Proof.
  induction e; intros s t Hs; simpl; try reflexivity;
  try (erewrite IHe; eauto using up_ext);
  try (erewrite IHe1; eauto using up_ext);
  try (erewrite IHe2; eauto using up_ext);
  try (erewrite IHe3; eauto using up_ext);
  try (f_equal; eauto using up_ext);
  try (apply Hs).
Qed.

Lemma up_subst_beta (b : expr) (sigma : var -> expr) (w : expr) :
  (forall x, closed_expr (sigma x)) ->
  (b.[up sigma]).[w .: ids] = b.[w .: sigma].
Proof.
  intros Hs.
  rewrite (expr_subst_comp b (up sigma) (w .: ids)).
  apply subst_ext. intro x.
  destruct x as [|n].
  - unfold up. simpl. reflexivity.
  - unfold up. simpl.
    rewrite rename_subst.
    rewrite (Hs n (ren (+1))).
    rewrite (Hs n (w .: ids)).
    reflexivity.

Definition Vstep (K : nat) (Vlow : nat -> VF) (Elow : nat -> EF) : VF :=
  fun rho Delta W tau v1 v2 =>
  match K with
  | 0 => True
  | S k' =>
    match tau with
    | TSec l t =>
      obs_case (interp_label rho l) (match t with
        | TUnit => True
        | TBool => v1 = v2
        | TNat => v1 = v2
        | TVar x => (Delta x).(tyrel) (S k') (interp_label rho l) W v1 v2
        | TProd tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | PairV a1 b1, PairV a2 b2 =>
                Vlow k' rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2 /\
                Vlow k' rho Delta W tau2 b1 b2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TSum tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | InjLV a1, InjLV a2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2
            | InjRV a1, InjRV a2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau2 a1 a2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TArrow _ tau1 tau2 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | LamV b1, LamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' ->
                  forall a1 a2,
                    Elow j rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2 ->
                    Elow j rho Delta W tau2 (App (Lam b1) a1) (App (Lam b2) a2)
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TRef tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | LocV l1, LocV l2 =>
                match wmap W l1 with
                | Some (l2', tau') =>
                    (l2' = l2) /\ (tau' = tau0) /\
                    match wst1 W !! l1, wst2 W !! l2 with
                    | Some x1, Some x2 => Vlow k' rho Delta W tau0 x1 x2
                    | _,_ => False
                    end
                | None => False
                end
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TForall _ tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | TLamV b1, TLamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' -> forall (R : TyRel),
                  Elow j rho (extend_tenv R Delta) W tau0
                    (TApp (TLam b1)) (TApp (TLam b2))
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TLForall _ tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | TLLamV b1, TLLamV b2 =>
                forall j, j < S k' -> forall (l' : label),
                  Elow j (extend_rho l' rho) Delta W tau0
                    (TLApp (TLLam b1)) (TLApp (TLLam b2))
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TExist tau0 =>
            match v1, v2 with
            | PackV a1, PackV a2 =>
                exists (R : TyRel),
                  Vlow k' rho (extend_tenv R Delta) W tau0 a1 a2
            | _,_ => False
            end
        | TRec tau0 =>
            Vlow k' rho Delta W
              (hsubst_sectype (TRec tau0 .: ids) tau0)
              (unfold_val v1) (unfold_val v2)
        end)
    end
  end.

Definition Frame (Vlow : nat -> VF) (r : nat) (W W' : World) : Prop :=
  forall j, j <= r -> forall rho Delta tau v1 v2,
    Vlow j rho Delta W tau v1 v2 -> Vlow j rho Delta W' tau v1 v2.

Proof.
  intros. unfold V. cbn [fam]. rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. cbn [Vstep].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma V_arrow_eq : forall k' rho Delta W l le tau1 tau2 (b1 b2 : expr),
  V (S k') rho Delta W (TArrow le tau1 tau2 @ l) (LamV b1) (LamV b2) <->
  obs_case (interp_label rho l)
    (forall j, j < S k' -> forall a1 a2,
        E j rho Delta W tau1 a1 a2 ->
        E j rho Delta W tau2 (App (Lam b1) a1) (App (Lam b2) a2)).
Proof.
  intros. unfold V. cbn [fam]. rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. cbn [Vstep].
  apply obs_case_iff. split; intros Hrel j Hj a1 a2 Harg.
  - assert (Hle : j <= k') by lia.
    specialize (Hrel j Hj a1 a2). rewrite <- (@Elow_fam k' j Hle) in Harg.
    apply Hrel in Harg. rewrite (@Elow_fam k' j Hle) in Harg. exact Harg.
  - assert (Hle : j <= k') by lia.
    specialize (Hrel j Hj a1 a2). rewrite (@Elow_fam k' j Hle) in Harg.
    apply Hrel in Harg. rewrite (@Elow_fam k' j Hle). exact Harg.
Qed.
  eapply obs_case_imp; [|exact Hs]. intro Hp. apply IH. exact Hp.
Qed.

Lemma V_mono_arrow_step :
  forall k' rho Delta W l le tau1 tau2 (v1 v2 : val),
  V (S (S k')) rho Delta W (TArrow le tau1 tau2 @ l) v1 v2 ->
  V (S k') rho Delta W (TArrow le tau1 tau2 @ l) v1 v2.
Proof.
  intros k' rho Delta W l le tau1 tau2 v1 v2 Hs.
  destruct v1; destruct v2;
  try (rewrite V_arrow_eq in Hs |- *; eapply obs_case_imp; [|exact Hs];

       rewrite Nat.eqb_refl in Hs |- *; cbn [Vstep] in Hs |- *; exact Hs).
Qed.

Lemma V_mono_forall_step :
  forall k' rho Delta W l le tau0 (v1 v2 : val),
        unfold obs_case. rewrite E'.
        apply (@tyrel_mono_label (Delta x) (interp_label rho l) (interp_label rho l') Hll (S k') W v1 v2).

           rewrite Nat.eqb_refl in Hs |- *; cbn [Vstep] in Hs |- *;
           exact (@obs_case_label_mono (interp_label rho l) (interp_label rho l') _ Hll Hs)).
    + (* TArrow *)
      destruct v1; destruct v2;
      try (rewrite V_arrow_eq in Hs |- *; exact (@obs_case_label_mono (interp_label rho l) (interp_label rho l') _ Hll Hs));
      try (unfold V in Hs |- *; cbn [fam] in Hs |- *;
           rewrite Nat.eqb_refl in Hs |- *; cbn [Vstep] in Hs |- *;
           exact (@obs_case_label_mono (interp_label rho l) (interp_label rho l') _ Hll Hs)).
    + (* TProd *)
      destruct v1; destruct v2;
      try (rewrite V_prod_eq in Hs |- *; exact (@obs_case_label_mono (interp_label rho l) (interp_label rho l') _ Hll Hs));
      try (unfold V in Hs |- *; cbn [fam] in Hs |- *;

Lemma fundamental_var : forall Gamma x tau,
  Gamma !! x = Some tau ->
  forall k rho Delta W d1 d2,
    EnvRel k rho Delta W Gamma d1 d2 ->
    E k rho Delta W tau (#(d1 x)) (#(d2 x)).
Proof.
  intros Gamma x tau Hx k rho Delta W d1 d2 Hrel.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - apply E_zero.
  - apply E_value.
    apply V_mono with (k := k').
    exact (@EnvRel_lookup (S k') rho Delta W Gamma d1 d2 x tau Hrel Hx).
Qed.

Lemma obs_case_label_mono : forall l l' (P : Prop),
  l ⊑ l' -> obs_case l P -> obs_case l' P.
Proof.
  intros l l' P Hle Ho. unfold obs_case in *.
  destruct (obs_bool l) eqn:El; destruct (obs_bool l') eqn:El'; simpl in *.
  - exact Ho.
  - exact I.
  - exfalso.
    assert (l ⊑ ζ) as Hlz.
    { eapply order_trans; [exact Hle | apply (proj1 (obs_bool_true l') El')]. }
    pose proof (proj2 (obs_bool_true l) Hlz) as Ht.
    rewrite El in Ht. discriminate.
  - exact I.
Qed.

  interp_label rho l ⊑ interp_label rho l' ->
  V k rho Delta W (t @ l) v1 v2 ->
  V k rho Delta W (t @ l') v1 v2.
Proof.
  intros k rho Delta W t l l' v1 v2 Hll Hs.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - apply V_zero.
  - destruct t.
    + rewrite V_unit_eq in Hs |- *. exact (@obs_case_label_mono (interp_label rho l) (interp_label rho l') _ Hll Hs).
    + rewrite V_bool_eq in Hs |- *. exact (@obs_case_label_mono (interp_label rho l) (interp_label rho l') _ Hll Hs).
    + rewrite V_nat_eq in Hs |- *. exact (@obs_case_label_mono (interp_label rho l) (interp_label rho l') _ Hll Hs).

Lemma rev_cons' {A : Type} (a : A) (l : list A) : rev (a :: l) = rev l ++ [a].
Proof. induction l as [|b l IH]; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fill_rev_cons (Ki : ectx_item) (L : list ectx_item) (e : expr) :
  fill (rev (Ki :: L)) e = fill_item Ki (fill (rev L) e).
Proof.
  rewrite rev_cons'. rewrite fill_app. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma app_fill_inv_rev (L : list ectx_item) (h f1 f2 : expr) :
  App f1 f2 = fill (rev L) h ->
  (rev L = [] /\ h = App f1 f2) \/
  (exists K', rev L = K' ++ [AppLCtx f2] /\ f1 = fill K' h) \/
  (exists v1 K', to_val f1 = Some v1 /\
      rev L = K' ++ [AppRCtx v1] /\ f2 = fill K' h).
Proof.
  intros Heq.
  induction L as [|Ki L' IH].
  - simpl in Heq. left. split; [reflexivity | symmetry; exact Heq].
  - rewrite fill_rev_cons in Heq.
    destruct Ki; simpl in Heq; try discriminate Heq.
    + (* AppLCtx e *) injection Heq as HX Harg.
      right; left. exists (rev L'). split.
      * rewrite rev_cons'. rewrite Harg. reflexivity.
      * exact HX.
    + (* AppRCtx v *) injection Heq as HX Harg.
      right; right. exists v1, (rev L'). split.
      * rewrite HX. apply to_val_of_val.
      * split.
        -- rewrite rev_cons'. reflexivity.
        -- exact Harg.
Qed.

Lemma app_fill_inv (K : list ectx_item) (h f1 f2 : expr) :
  App f1 f2 = fill K h ->
  (K = [] /\ h = App f1 f2) \/
  (exists K', K = K' ++ [AppLCtx f2] /\ f1 = fill K' h) \/
  (exists v1 K', to_val f1 = Some v1 /\
      K = K' ++ [AppRCtx v1] /\ f2 = fill K' h).
Proof.
  intros Heq.
  pose proof (app_fill_inv_rev (rev K) h f1 f2) as Hinv.
  rewrite rev_involutive in Hinv.
  apply Hinv. exact Heq.
Qed.


Lemma head_step_app_inv (f1 f2 : expr) (σ : state) (e' : expr) (σ' : state) :
  head_step (App f1 f2) σ [] e' σ' [] ->
  exists body v2, f1 = Lam body /\ to_val f2 = Some v2 /\
    e' = body.[f2/] /\ σ' = σ.
Proof.
  intros Hs. inversion Hs; subst; try discriminate.
  exists e1, v2. repeat split; auto.
Qed.


Lemma pstep_app_inv (f1 f2 : expr) (σ : state) (e' : expr) (σ' : state) :
  pstep (App f1 f2, σ) (e', σ') ->
  (exists f1', e' = App f1' f2 /\ pstep (f1, σ) (f1', σ')) \/
  (exists v1, to_val f1 = Some v1 /\
     ((exists f2', e' = App (#v1) f2' /\ pstep (f2, σ) (f2', σ')) \/
      (exists body v2, f1 = Lam body /\ to_val f2 = Some v2 /\
          e' = body.[f2/] /\ σ' = σ))).
Proof.
  intros Hp. inversion Hp as [K h h' Hfill Heq Hhead]; subst. simpl in *.
  destruct (app_fill_inv K h f1 f2 Hfill) as
    [[HK Hh] | [[K' [HK Hf1]] | [v1 [K' [Hv1 [HK Hf2]]]]]]; subst.
  - (* K=[] *)
    destruct (head_step_app_inv f1 f2 σ h' σ' Hhead) as
      [body [v2 [Hf1 [Hv2 [He' Hs']]]]].
    right. exists (LamV body). split.
    + rewrite Hf1. exact (to_val_of_val (LamV body)).
    + right. exists body, v2. repeat split; auto.
  - (* AppLCtx *)
    left. exists (fill K' h'). split.
    + rewrite fill_app. simpl. reflexivity.
    + eapply Ectx_step; eauto.
  - (* AppRCtx *)
    right. exists v1. split.
    + exact Hv1.
    + left. exists (fill K' h'). split.
      * rewrite fill_app. simpl. reflexivity.
      * eapply Ectx_step; eauto.
Qed.


Lemma pstep_app_lam_inv (b1 a1 : expr) (σ : state) (e' : expr) (σ' : state) :
  pstep (App (Lam b1) a1, σ) (e', σ') ->
  (exists a1', e' = App (Lam b1) a1' /\ pstep (a1, σ) (a1', σ')) \/
  (exists w1, to_val a1 = Some w1 /\ e' = b1.[a1/] /\ σ' = σ).
Proof.
  intros Hp.
  destruct (pstep_app_inv (Lam b1) a1 σ e' σ' Hp) as
    [[f1' [He' Hstep]] |
     [v1 [Hval [[a1' [He' Hstep]] |
                [body [w2 [Hf1 [Hval2 [He' Hs']]]]]]]]].
  - exfalso. exact (pstep_value (LamV b1) σ f1' σ' Hstep).
  - assert (v1 = LamV b1) as Hv1.
    { inversion Hval. reflexivity. }
    subst v1. left. exists a1'. split; auto.
  - inversion Hf1 as [Hb]. subst body. right. exists w2. split; [exact Hval2 | split].
    + exact He'.
    + exact Hs'.
Qed.


Lemma steps_app_lam_value_inv (n : nat) (b1 a1 : expr) (σ : state) (v : val) (σ' : state) :
  steps n (App (Lam b1) a1, σ) (#v, σ') ->
  exists m m' w1 σ1,
    steps m (a1, σ) (#w1, σ1) /\
    steps m' (b1.[#w1/], σ1) (#v, σ') /\
    n = S (m + m').
Proof.
  revert b1 a1 σ v σ'.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros b1 a1 σ v σ' Hs.
  - inversion Hs. destruct v; simpl in H0; discriminate H0.
  - inversion Hs; subst. simpl in H1. destruct y as [ey σy].
    destruct (pstep_app_lam_inv b1 a1 σ ey σy H1) as
      [[a1' [He' Hstepa]] | [w1 [Hval [He' Hs']]]].
    + subst ey. simpl in Hstepa.
      destruct (IH b1 a1' σy v σ' H2) as [m [m' [w1 [σ1 [Hrun1 [Hbody Hn]]]]]].
      exists (S m), m', w1, σ1. split.
      * apply (steps_S m (a1, σ) (a1', σy) (#w1, σ1) Hstepa Hrun1).
      * split.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Label-term semantics and soundness of the syntactic flow relation.  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint interp_label (rho : var -> label) (l : label_term) : label :=
  match l with
  | LVar x => rho x
  | LJoin a b => interp_label rho a ⊔ interp_label rho b
  | LLabel x => x
  end.

Lemma interp_label_subst (rho : var -> label) (sigma : var -> label_term)
Lemma E_S_eq : forall k' rho Delta W tau e1 e2,
  E (S k') rho Delta W tau e1 e2 <->
  (forall (n1 n2 : nat) (v1 v2 : val) (s1 s2 : state),
      steps n1 (e1, wst1 W) (#v1, s1) ->
      steps n2 (e2, wst2 W) (#v2, s2) ->
      n1 + n2 <= S k' ->
      exists (wm' : loc -> option (loc * sectype)),
        (forall l l' tau0, wmap W l = Some (l', tau0) -> wm' l = Some (l', tau0)) /\
        V (S k' - n1 - n2 - 1) rho Delta (s1, s2, wm') tau v1 v2 /\
        FrameV (S k' - n1 - n2 - 1) W (s1, s2, wm')).
Proof.
  intros. unfold E. cbn [fam]. rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. cbn [Estep].
  split; intros Hrel n1 n2 v1 v2 s1 s2 Hs1 Hs2 Hle.
  - destruct (Hrel n1 n2 v1 v2 s1 s2 Hs1 Hs2 Hle) as [wm' [Hext [HV HF]]].
    exists wm'. split; [exact Hext | split].
    + assert (Hr : S k' - n1 - n2 - 1 <= k') by lia.
      rewrite <- (@Vlow_fam k' (S k' - n1 - n2 - 1) Hr). exact HV.
    + assert (Hr : S k' - n1 - n2 - 1 <= k') by lia.
      apply (proj1 (Frame_fam k' (S k' - n1 - n2 - 1) W (s1, s2, wm') Hr)). exact HF.
  - destruct (Hrel n1 n2 v1 v2 s1 s2 Hs1 Hs2 Hle) as [wm' [Hext [HV HF]]].
    exists wm'. split; [exact Hext | split].
    + assert (Hr : S k' - n1 - n2 - 1 <= k') by lia.
      rewrite (@Vlow_fam k' (S k' - n1 - n2 - 1) Hr). exact HV.
    + assert (Hr : S k' - n1 - n2 - 1 <= k') by lia.
      apply (proj2 (Frame_fam k' (S k' - n1 - n2 - 1) W (s1, s2, wm') Hr)). exact HF.
Qed.



Lemma obs_bool_true : forall l : label, obs_bool l = true <-> l ⊑ ζ.
Lemma E_zero : forall rho Delta W tau (e1 e2 : expr), E 0 rho Delta W tau e1 e2.
Proof. intros. unfold E. cbn [fam]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma E_value : forall k' rho Delta W tau (v1 v2 : val),
  V k' rho Delta W tau v1 v2 ->
  E (S k') rho Delta W tau (#v1) (#v2).
Proof.
  intros k' rho Delta W tau v1 v2 HV.
  destruct W as [[s1 s2] wm]. simpl in *.
  apply E_S_eq. intros n1 n2 w1 w2 t1 t2 Hs1 Hs2 Hle.
  destruct (steps_value_inv n1 v1 s1 (#w1) t1 Hs1) as [Hn1 [He1 Hs1']].
  destruct (steps_value_inv n2 v2 s2 (#w2) t2 Hs2) as [Hn2 [He2 Hs2']].
  subst n1 n2. exists wm. split.
  - intros l l' tau0 Hm. exact Hm.
  - split.
    + subst t1 t2. apply of_val_inj in He1. apply of_val_inj in He2. subst w1 w2.
      replace (S k' - 0 - 0 - 1) with k' by lia. exact HV.
    + subst t1 t2. replace (S k' - 0 - 0 - 1) with k' by lia. apply FrameV_refl.
Qed.

From Autosubst Require Export Autosubst.

From logrel_ifc.lambda_sec Require Export lang lattice types.

Section lambda_sec_typing.

Context `{SecurityLattice label}.

Inductive subtype : type → type → Prop :=
  | TSubRefl t :
      subtype t t
  | TSubTrans t1 t2 t3 :
      subtype t1 t2 → subtype t2 t3 → subtype t1 t3
  | TArrowSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
      secsubtype τ1' τ1 →
      secsubtype τ2 τ2' →
      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
      subtype (TArrow ℓₑ1 τ1 τ2) (TArrow ℓₑ2 τ1' τ2')
  | TForallSub τ1 τ2 ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
      secsubtype τ1 τ2 →
      subtype (TForall ℓₑ1 τ1) (TForall ℓₑ2 τ2)
  | TLForallSub τ1 τ2 ℓₑ1 ℓₑ2 :
      ℓₑ2 ⊑ₛ ℓₑ1 →
      secsubtype τ1 τ2 →
      subtype (TLForall ℓₑ1 τ1) (TLForall ℓₑ2 τ2)
  | TProdSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
      secsubtype τ1 τ1' → secsubtype τ2 τ2' → subtype (TProd τ1 τ2) (TProd τ1' τ2')
  | TSumSub τ1 τ1' τ2 τ2' :
      secsubtype τ1 τ1' → secsubtype τ2 τ2' → subtype (TSum τ1 τ2) (TSum τ1' τ2')

  | TRecSub τ1 τ2 :


      secsubtype τ1.|[TRec τ1/] τ2.|[TRec τ2/] →
      subtype (TRec τ1) (TRec τ2)
  with secsubtype :  sectype → sectype → Prop :=
  | TSubsec (ℓ ℓ' : label_term) (t t' : type) :
      ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓ' → subtype t t' → secsubtype (t @ ℓ) (t' @ ℓ').

Scheme subtype_mut := Induction for subtype Sort Prop
    with secsubtype_mut := Induction for secsubtype Sort Prop.

Notation "t1 '<:' t2" := (subtype t1 t2) (at level 70).

Notation "τ1 '<:ₛ' τ2" := (secsubtype τ1 τ2) (at level 70).

Definition type_flowsto τ ℓ :=
    let: t @ ℓ' := τ in ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓ'.

Notation "τ ↘ ℓ" := (type_flowsto τ ℓ) (at level 70).

Definition binop_type (op : binop) : type :=
    match op with
    | Add | Sub | Mult => TNat
    | Eq | Le | Lt => TBool
  end.

Reserved Notation "Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ" (at level 74, e, τ at next level).

Inductive typed (Γ : list sectype) (pc : label_term) : expr → sectype → Prop :=
  | Unit_typed : Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Unit : TUnit @ ⊥ₛ
  | Bool_typed b :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Bool b : TBool @ ⊥ₛ
  | Nat_typed n :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Nat n : TNat @ ⊥ₛ
  | Var_typed x τ :
      Γ !! x = Some τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Var x : τ
  | Lam_typed e ℓₑ τ1 τ2 :
      τ1 :: Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Lam e : (TArrow ℓₑ τ1 τ2) @ ⊥ₛ
  | BinOp_typed e1 e2 op ℓ1 ℓ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : TNat @ ℓ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : TNat @ ℓ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ BinOp op e1 e2 : (binop_type op) @ (ℓ1 ⊔ₛ ℓ2)
  | App_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 ℓ ℓₑ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : (TArrow ℓₑ τ1 τ2) @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ1 →
      τ2 ↘ ℓ →
      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ App e1 e2 : τ2
  | LetIn_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
      τ1 :: Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ LetIn e1 e2 : τ2
  | Seq_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Seq e1 e2 : τ2
  | TLam_typed e τ ℓₑ :
      hsubst_sectype (ren (+1)) <$> Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLam e : (TForall ℓₑ τ) @ ⊥ₛ
  | TApp_typed e τ t' ℓ ℓₑ :
      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ →
      τ.|[t'/] ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : (TForall ℓₑ τ) @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TApp e : τ.|[t'/]
  | TLLam_typed e τ ℓₑ :
      hsubst_label_sectype (ren (+1)) <$> Γ # ℓₑ ⊢ₜ e : τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLLam e : (TLForall ℓₑ τ) @ ⊥ₛ
  | TLApp_typed e τ (ℓ ℓ' ℓₑ : label_term) :
      pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊑ₛ ℓₑ.[ℓ'/] →
      τ.|[ℓ'/] ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : (TLForall ℓₑ τ) @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ TLApp e : τ.|[ℓ'/]
  | Cond_typed e e1 e2 τ ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TBool @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e1 : τ →
      Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
      τ ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ If e e1 e2 : τ
  | Pair_typed e1 e2 τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : τ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Pair e1 e2 : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
  | Proj1_typed e τ1 τ2 ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
      τ1 ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Proj1 e : τ1
  | Proj2_typed e τ1 τ2 ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TProd τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
      τ2 ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Proj2 e : τ2
  | InjL_typed e τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ1 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ InjL e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
  | InjR_typed e τ1 τ2 :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ2 →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ InjR e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ⊥ₛ
  | Case_typed e e1 e2 τ1 τ2 τ ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TSum τ1 τ2 @ ℓ →
       τ1 :: Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e1 : τ →
       τ2 :: Γ # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
      τ ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Case e e1 e2 : τ
  | Alloc_typed e τ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ →
      τ ↘ pc →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Alloc e : TRef τ @ ⊥ₛ
  | Store_typed e1 e2 τ ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : TRef τ @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e2 : τ →
      τ ↘ pc ⊔ₛ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Store e1 e2 : TUnit @ ⊥ₛ
  | Load_typed e τ τ' ℓ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TRef τ @ ℓ →
      τ <:ₛ τ' →
      τ' ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Load e : τ'
  | TPack e τ t :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ.|[t/] →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Pack e : TExist τ @ ⊥ₛ
  | TUnpack e1 e2 τ1 τ2 ℓ :
      τ2 ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e1 : TExist τ1 @ ℓ →
      τ1 :: (hsubst_sectype (ren (+1)) <$> Γ) # pc ⊔ₛ ℓ ⊢ₜ e2 : (hsubst_sectype (ren (+1)) τ2) →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Unpack e1 e2 : τ2
  | TFold e τ :
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ.|[TRec τ/] →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Fold e : TRec τ @ ⊥ₛ
  | TUnfold e τ ℓ :
      τ.|[TRec τ/] ↘ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : TRec τ @ ℓ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ Unfold e : τ.|[TRec τ/]
  | Sub_typed e τ τ' pc' :
      Γ # pc' ⊢ₜ e : τ' →
      pc ⊑ₛ pc' →
      τ' <:ₛ τ →
      Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ
  where "Γ # pc ⊢ₜ e : τ" := (typed Γ pc e τ).

Fixpoint env_subst (vs : list val) : var → expr :=
    match vs with
    | [] => ids
    | v :: vs' => #v .: env_subst vs'
    end.

End lambda_sec_typing.
